jobs.description:
Opportunity in Chicago

At a Glance

  • Based in: Chicago, IL (a key business district)
  • Employer: UPS (Hiring in Chicago)
  • Compensation: $22-$25/Hour (approx. $28.4k/Year)
  • Flexible Role in Chicago: Night Sort Warehouse Associate
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.
  • Project-based work with clear objectives.
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

About FedEx

The global reach of FedEx is powered by our incredibly advanced network of processing hubs and distribution centers. Behind every package safely delivered is a dedicated team working diligently to sort, route, and load freight with speed and precision. We are committed to creating a diverse, energetic, and safe workplace where hard work is recognized and career advancement is highly encouraged.

Position Overview

We invite reliable and energetic individuals to join our team as a FedEx Package Handler. In this essential warehouse role, you are the driving force behind our supply chain. You will work in a fast-paced, highly physical environment, manually loading and unloading trailers and operating scanning equipment to ensure packages are routed to the correct destination. This is a phenomenal entry-level opportunity for individuals looking to build physical stamina and launch a career in logistics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely load and unload packages from commercial trailers and delivery vehicles in a timely manner.
  • Scan package barcodes to ensure precise tracking and correct routing within the facility.
  • Sort packages methodically by zip code and destination onto conveyor belts and pallets.
  • Maintain a clean and organized workspace, strictly adhering to all FedEx safety and material-handling protocols.

Qualifications and Benefits

Applicants must be at least 18 years old and possess the physical stamina to continuously lift, push, and pull packages weighing up to 50 pounds throughout the shift. A positive attitude and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment are essential. We offer competitive hourly pay, flexible shift options (including part-time and full-time), tuition assistance programs, and excellent opportunities to advance into management or driving roles within the company.

About UPS & Our Culture

Friday evening through Sunday night — that is when the UPS weekend operation runs at its highest volume, and it is when our Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers earn some of the strongest hourly rates in our entire package center network. If your Monday-through-Friday schedule is locked and you are hunting for weekend warehouse jobs that actually pay well, offer union benefits, and leave every weekday untouched, UPS weekend shifts were designed specifically for you. We are one of the only employers in the logistics industry offering weekend warehouse jobs near me with full Teamsters union representation, meaning your weekend hours come with the same contractual protections and pay guarantees as any full-time role.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I have a full-time desk job Monday through Friday and I work UPS weekends to pay down my mortgage faster. The weekend differential on top of the union wage makes the hourly rate genuinely excellent, and I get my full weekdays completely untouched. In two years I have built a serious financial cushion on this schedule. If you are looking for legitimate weekend warehouse jobs near me that respect your weekday life, UPS is it." - Current Weekend Package Handler, Indianapolis, IN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handler, you work Friday evening through Sunday sort shifts inside our package center, processing the weekend's elevated residential delivery and pickup volume that builds throughout the week and peaks on Saturday and Sunday sort windows.

  • Weekend Volume Processing: Sort, load, and unload the high-density package volume that accumulates through the week, operating at peak throughput across Friday night, Saturday, and Sunday shifts to clear the facility for Monday morning delivery routes.
  • Weekend Surge Handling: Navigate the additional volume generated by weekend e-commerce orders and residential pickups, adapting quickly to higher-than-weekday sort targets that UPS weekend shifts routinely reach.
  • Trailer Loading & Unloading: Pull inbound packages from arriving trailers and build outbound loads in package cars and linehaul lanes, using UPS-approved stacking methods to maintain load quality standards across all weekend shifts.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers receive a weekend shift differential on top of the Teamsters base union wage. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance apply regardless of your part-time weekend schedule. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday. Your entire Monday-through-Friday schedule remains completely untouched.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at www.dol.gov/ofccp .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder

jobs.description:
• Base Pay $19.00 / Hour
  • Job Category Manufacturing
  • Employee Type Regular Full Time

BASIC PURPOSE OF POSITION

To safely operate powered material handling equipment as required by the assigned department.

This position will require the employee to work overtime as needed. Overtime is scheduled based upon individual job responsibilities and the needs of the department.

MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Must follow Jel Sert safety procedures, GMP requirements and work instructions.
  • Pick and load product onto trailers as specified on bill of lading paperwork.
  • Unload and stage product and/or materials from trailers as specified on bill of lading paperwork.
  • Set up and remove production materials from production lines.
  • Transport finished product from production lines.
  • Report any safety and quality issues to shift supervisor and/or lead.
  • Perform other work as required such as performing accurate cycle counts.
  • May be required to perform preventative maintenance on assigned equipment.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Keep work area(s) clean and free of safety hazards.

FOOD SAFETY/QUALITY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Follow applicable work procedures and instructions; final inspection of product and trucks (Distribution Center) and monitor quality control points (QCP's).

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Ability to operate forklift and other similar powered industrial equipment in a safe and efficient manner while causing minimal damage to finished product and materials.
  • Ability to successfully complete forklift certification training and exam.
  • Good oral and written English skills.
  • Complete understanding of GMP and Jel Sert safety procedures and policies.
  • Must be able to correctly follow warehouse management system procedures and utilize related equipment such as scanners.
  • Previous experience in powered industrial equipment preferred, but not required.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Manufacturing/Distribution and a fast-paced environment.
  • A full range of motion is required (reaching and lifting), lifting up to 50 lbs. alone.
  • Standing or sitting for the duration of a shift (8 or more hours).
  • Continuous work.
  • Possible exposures to various odors and dust.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Mandatory overtime during the week and/or weekend required as necessary.

Additional Information

  • Scheduled Work Hours 2:30pm-10:30pm, Monday - Saturday

jobs.description:
Role Based in Chicago

Key Information

  • Employer: UPS (Hiring in Chicago)
  • Salary: $20-$24/Hour (approx. $46.2k/Year)
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Job Title: Full-time Night Shift Warehouse Unloader (Gig/Contract)
  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.
  • Based in: Chicago, IL (a vibrant local hub)
  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

The night shift unload is the most physically demanding and most financially rewarding entry-level position in the UPS warehouse network. Our Full-Time Night Shift Unloaders are the associates who set the entire sort operation in motion every evening — pulling packages from trailers at sustained speed so that the entire downstream sort, load, and dispatch chain can execute without interruption. If you are seeking full-time night shift warehouse jobs that pay a premium for working hours others avoid, reward physical effort with contractually guaranteed union wages, and open the door to one of the most financially powerful blue-collar careers in America, this is the opportunity you have been looking for.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I specifically wanted a full-time night shift because I do not want to deal with traffic and I am naturally a night person. The UPS overnight differential on top of the full-time union wage makes my take-home pay genuinely outstanding for the skill level required to start. I have been here four years, I make more than most of my college-educated friends, and I am currently in the line for a full-time driver position. Full-time night shift warehouse jobs do not get better than this." - Current Full-Time Night Shift Unloader, Memphis, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Full-Time Night Shift Warehouse Unloader, you work an 8-hour overnight shift inside our package center, leading the high-velocity inbound unload operation that processes all trailers arriving during the night sort window and sets up the entire sort floor for the day ahead.

  • High-Speed Trailer Unloading: Pull packages from fully loaded 53-foot inbound trailers at a sustained rate across a full 8-hour shift, placing every parcel label-side up on the inbound conveyor belt to maintain sort floor throughput targets through the peak overnight window.
  • Inbound Freight Verification: Identify and flag trailer shortages, damaged freight, and hazmat packages at the point of unload before any problem item enters the main sort flow, protecting downstream sort accuracy and compliance.
  • Dock Safety Leadership: Model UPS safety protocols — trailer chocking, dock plate seating, and heavy-lift team technique — for newer associates in the unload area, setting the standard that keeps the night shift injury-free shift after shift.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Full-Time Night Shift Unloaders earn a significant overnight shift differential stacked on top of the full-time Teamsters union base wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available in the package logistics industry without a CDL. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, a defined-benefit pension, paid vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance are all included. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday.

jobs.title: Public Safety Officer (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
HIRING RANGE:  $18.77 - $23.00 Hourly

FULL SALARY RANGE:   $18.77 - $27.22 Hourly

THIS POSTING MAY CLOSE AT ANY TIME ONCE A SUFFICIENT NUMBER OF APPLICATIONS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED


Make a Difference While Earning Your Degree!
Are you currently enrolled in college or planning to attend soon? Join the City of Allen as a Part-Time Public Safety Officer (PSO) and gain hands-on experience in public safety while setting yourself up for future career success.

Tuition Reimbursement Available!
Eligible part-time PSOs can receive financial tuition assistance for up to 12 credit hours per semester (at Collin College rates). Reimbursement is contingent on successful course completion—helping you stay on track toward your degree with less financial burden.

A Stepping Stone to a Career in Law Enforcement
This position offers valuable, real-world experience that can serve as a pathway to becoming a Police Officer in the future.

Join the City of Allen—a vibrant community of over 100,000 residents where strong economic growth, excellent schools, and an exceptional quality of life make it a great place to live, work, and play.

Our mission is simple: “To achieve excellence in managing community development and city services, continually enhancing the quality of life and public confidence.”

At the City of Allen, our employees bring the PRIDE values to life:

  • People First – Prioritizing others
  • Respect – Treating everyone with courtesy and dignity
  • Integrity – Serving with honesty and trust
  • Deliver – Following through and exceeding expectations
  • Excel – Driving innovation and continuous improvement

We do Work that MATTERS! Join a team that serves our community and makes a real impact every day. Learn more about the City of Allen at allentx.gov.


The purpose of this position is to serve the citizens of the City and visitors to the Police Department. This is accomplished by completing station duties, greeting the public, answering and directing telephone calls, documenting calls for service via the telephone or walk-in complaints, and assisting Police Officers with low priority calls. Other duties include obtaining facts and reporting facts effectively in a written report in order to allow for follow-up investigation or clearance to be made in the case.

The following duties ARE NOT intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties performed by all employees in this classification, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities. Incumbent(s) may not be required to perform all duties listed and may be required to perform additional, position-specific duties.


  • Greets and directs the public, keeps a log of and disseminates proper identification badges for visitors to the department, receive and process mail and packages, manage fingerprint requests, answer phones and direct telephone requests, requests police officers or detention officers when necessary. 
  • Documents calls for service via the telephone or walk-in complaints by obtaining pertinent facts and determining appropriate response. Writes and inputs reports into the department's computer system to allow for follow-up investigation or clearance to made in the case. Makes NCIC/TCIC inquiries as they apply to the specific report.
  • Informs complainants that an official offense/incident report has been filed, gives complainants service numbers, and explains the departmental complaint process. Photographs and registers sex offenders.
  • Participates in the crime scene reporting process by taking photographs, dusting for fingerprints, logging physical evidence and completing evidence reports.
  • Uses the Penal Code in assisting Police Officers with traffic control, responding to low priority (level 3 &4) calls and performing security patrols. Uses interview techniques when interacting with citizens regarding various elements of the law (property, white-collar crime, drug crimes, etc.).
  • Enhances public safety and supports police operations by performing fieldwork in all weather conditions.
  • Operates under the City of Allen’s core values of People First, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Excel.

Education & Experience 
Work requires broad knowledge in a general professional or technical field. Education and experience that provide the necessary knowledge and skills may also be considered, but a typical way to qualify is by obtaining:

  • a High School diploma or equivalent with no prior relevant work experience.

Certification and Other Requirements 

  • Valid Texas Class C Driver's License.

Schedule
Front desk hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Candidates must be available to work shifts within this time frame, with a maximum of 19 hours per week.

Physical Demands / Work Environment
  • Ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions.
  • Periods of standing and walking relevant to traffic control, assisting motorists, and crime prevention patrols. 
  • Additional work within an office environment.

About GardaWorld

GardaWorld is a global champion in security services, integrated risk management, and cash solutions. We protect the high-value assets of financial institutions, major retailers, and government agencies worldwide. We offer our employees a robust, highly secure working environment where discipline, integrity, and safety are the highest operational priorities. We pride ourselves on hiring professionals who thrive in high-stakes environments.

A Timeline of Your Daily Operations

  • 6:00 AM - Secure Dispatch: Arrive at the heavily fortified GardaWorld vault facility. You will arm yourself, review the daily manifest with your partner, and conduct a rigorous mechanical and security inspection of the armored commercial vehicle.
  • 7:30 AM - Tactical Routing: Navigate the armored vehicle safely through dense city traffic or suburban routes. You must maintain absolute situational awareness and utilize defensive driving techniques to prevent accidents and mitigate security risks.
  • 10:00 AM - Asset Transfer: Act as the armed messenger. You will exit the vehicle to securely deliver and pick up cash deposits, coins, and valuable assets from retail clients and ATMs, operating with hyper-vigilance while your partner secures the perimeter.
  • 3:00 PM - Vault Reconciliation: Return safely to the branch facility. You will follow strict, heavily audited procedures to transfer the collected assets back into the vault and complete all digital and physical chain-of-custody paperwork.

The Security Advantage

This is a highly structured, rewarding role that combines commercial driving with elite physical security. You will enjoy a predictable daytime schedule. GardaWorld provides a highly competitive hourly wage, comprehensive medical and dental insurance, robust 401(k) options, and all necessary tactical and firearms training.

Qualifications

Must be at least 21 years of age. A valid driver's license with a pristine driving record is required (commercial license preferred but not always mandatory). You must possess or be willing and able to obtain a state-issued armed security guard license and a permit to carry a firearm. A flawless criminal background, exceptional ethical integrity, and the physical ability to lift heavy coin bags (up to 50 lbs) are mandatory.

jobs.description:
Local Job Overview: East Chicago

Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate Company: UPS Location: East Chicago, IN

Salary: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $30.7k/Year) Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included. Clear growth pathways at our East Chicago office.

Position Scope

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Package Logistics.

  • This East Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in East Chicago, IN is growing.
  • Benefit from working in East Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

jobs.title: Chicago Career:Quality Control Warehouse Associate at UPS | Hiring
jobs.description:
Position in Chicago, IL

Snapshot

  • Company: UPS
  • Worksite: Chicago, IL
  • Role in Chicago: Quality Control Warehouse Associate
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

Salary and Benefits

  • Pay: $18-$21/Hour (approx. $41.5k/Year)
  • Benefits: Eligible team members receive standard benefits.
  • Impactful work with supportive local leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.

About UPS & Our Culture

Precision is the promise UPS makes to every customer, and our Quality Control team is the internal force that keeps that promise intact. QC Associates audit the sort operation in real time — catching misloads, verifying scan compliance, and inspecting load quality before a single truck leaves the building. If you are searching for analytical UPS warehouse jobs that reward a sharp eye and a methodical mindset over raw physical speed, Quality Control is the most intellectually engaging role on the sort floor. These are warehouse jobs that directly protect the UPS service guarantee and drive some of the strongest internal logistics careers in our operations network.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"QC work suits my personality perfectly. I am not the fastest loader in the building, but I can spot a misload in three seconds and I find the audit process genuinely satisfying. Management noticed my accuracy rate and I was moved into a quality trainer role within a year. The UPS internal track rewards precision just as much as speed, and that is something most warehouse jobs never offer." - Current Quality Control Associate, Minneapolis, MN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Quality Control Warehouse Associate, you conduct real-time audits of sort accuracy, load quality, and scan compliance across the active sort floor inside our package center, catching errors before they generate service failures for UPS customers.

  • Misload Auditing: Systematically scan packages inside loaded package cars against the assigned route manifest, identifying any package loaded into the wrong vehicle and immediately correcting the misload before the driver departs.
  • Scan Compliance Verification: Audit sort belt scan rates in real time, identifying packages that bypassed the scan tunnel without a valid read and manually scanning them into the system to maintain chain-of-custody accuracy.
  • Load Quality Inspection: Walk loaded package cars before departure to verify that load quality meets UPS standards — no overhanging packages, heavy items on shelves not floors, fragile items in protected positions — documenting violations and coaching loaders immediately.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Quality Control Associates receive Teamsters union wages, full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program. The analytical nature of this role creates a direct pathway into UPS operations management and industrial engineering career tracks.

Position in Berwyn, IL

Position: Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate (Based in Berwyn) Company: UPS Location: Berwyn, IL

Salary: $21-$23/Hour (approx. $26.6k/Year) Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included. Clear growth pathways at our Berwyn office.

Responsibilities

This role centers on your professional skills within the Package Logistics space in Berwyn.

  • This Berwyn-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Berwyn, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Berwyn, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

The twilight shift is one of the highest-volume sort windows in the entire UPS network, processing the enormous wave of packages picked up from businesses throughout the workday. If you are searching for UPS warehouse jobs that align perfectly with a daytime school schedule or a morning-shift primary job, our twilight sort operation — typically running 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM — is the ideal entry into one of America's most respected logistics careers. These warehouse jobs come with full union representation and real long-term potential.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The twilight shift fits my life perfectly. I go to class in the morning, work at UPS in the evening, and my tuition is being covered by Earn & Learn. The shift itself is fast and the team is incredibly motivated — everyone knows we have a hard window to hit and we go after it together. These are the best UPS warehouse jobs for students, hands down." - Current Twilight Warehouse Associate, Chicago, IL.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate, you process the peak commercial pickup volume of the day during the evening sort window. You will rotate through loading, sorting, and unloading functions as directed by your sort manager within our package center.

  • Commercial Pickup Processing: Sort the high-density commercial package volume collected from business pickups during the day, routing each parcel accurately onto outbound belts and trailers for overnight transport.
  • Multi-Function Rotation: Work fluidly across unloading, sorting, and loading assignments as the twilight sort manager redistributes labor to balance throughput across the facility's busiest evening hours.
  • Sort Accuracy Compliance: Maintain UPS's required sort accuracy rate by carefully verifying destination labels and barcode scans before releasing any package onto an outbound conveyor.

Benefits & Perks

Twilight Warehouse Associates receive Teamsters union wages with annual progression raises, medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition program. The evening shift window makes this one of the most student-friendly warehouse jobs in the market.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Security Overnight Officer to safeguard our bustling plaza during nighttime hours. In this dynamic role, you will be responsible for maintaining a secure environment through proactive surveillance, access control, and incident management. Your presence will ensure the safety of visitors, staff, and property while upholding the highest standards of security compliance. This position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security expertise in a fast-paced setting, contributing to a safe and welcoming atmosphere around the clock.

Duties

  • Conduct continuous CCTV surveillance and monitor security cameras to detect suspicious activity or security breaches.
  • Perform routine patrols of the plaza premises, including parking areas, entrances, and common spaces to identify potential hazards or unauthorized access.
  • Verifying identities and authorizations for staff, visitors, and contractors.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations using established procedures, including fire alarms, medical incidents, or security threats.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security-related events or disturbances for review and follow-up.
  • Utilize conflict de-escalation techniques to manage disputes calmly and professionally while ensuring safety for all parties involved.

Experience

  • Vaild Drivers License/ Clean Driving Record
  • Active PERC/ 20 hr.
  • Prior experience in physical security, law enforcement, military service, or related fields is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in surveillance techniques using CCTV systems and access control technology.
  • Knowledge of emergency response procedures including first aid, CPR, AED operation, and fire safety protocols.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks such as heavy lifting when required for equipment or incident management.
  • Strong skills in incident report writing with attention to detail and clarity.
  • Familiarity with conflict management strategies and conflict de-escalation methods.

Join us as a Security Overnight Plaza team member and play a vital role in creating a safe environment that promotes peace of mind for everyone who visits or works at our plaza. Your dedication will help foster a secure community while advancing your career in security operations!

Pay: From $18.50 per hour

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.



As a GSOC Operator, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, Healthcare, Education, Government and more. The Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) Operator, under guidance of GSOC Supervisor, is responsible for assisting company personnel in all concerns that pertain to safety and security for corporate locations around the globe. The individual will work in a GSOC environment, monitoring several screens. The Operator will use a variety of tools that range from access control and alarm monitoring systems to various business intelligence sources, open-source media, Internet, and in-house tools. The Operator is required to detect, analyze, and alert others of any incidents which may impact the client’s people, products, property, or brand image. These may range from extreme weather conditions, political instability, crime, terror, to technical failures.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $22.00 / Hour

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide customer service to our clients by carrying out safety and security procedures, site-specific policies and when appropriate, emergency response activities
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem solving manner
  • Investigate alarms and respond by sending security patrol, or alerting Fire services or Police as needed
  • Assist company employees in all concerns that pertain to safety and security
  • Monitor travel safety and security of company’s employees

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent, or five (5) years of verifiable experience
  • Minimum of two (2) years of military, law enforcement, government, or security experience
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws. Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
    *A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only

BENEFITS:

  • Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • Enrollment in our company’s 401 (k) or Supplemental Income Plan, subject to eligibility requirements
  • Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal day
  • 40 hours of vacation after one year of employment at eligible work assignments. Unused vacation is only paid out where required by law.

jobs.title: Substitute Security Guard
jobs.description:
Primary Purpose: Under general supervision, provide security and protection for students, staff, and visitors and prevent property loss due to theft or vandalism.

Qualifications

Education/Certification: High School Diploma or GED Security Officer commissioned by Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) or hold other appropriate license Completed DPS Level II or III training course Clear and valid Texas driver’s license Special

Knowledge/Skills: Ability to clearly and accurately record information Ability to follow verbal and written instructions Ability to work effectively with youths and adults Ability to communicate effectively (verbally)

Experience: None

Major Responsibilities And Duties

Safety Management

  • Patrol assigned campus(es) and/or district facilities. Monitor student behavior and enforce school rules related to student conduct, vehicle operation, and parking.
  • Resolve conflict or confrontation between students and report disturbances to principal or assistant principal.
  • Control traffic and parking on district grounds during school hours and at after-hours events.
  • Document incidents in security logs and compile and file required reports.
  • Help provide traffic control at athletic events, school closings or openings, or at any other time.
  • May serve on district or campus behavioral threat assessment and safe and supportive schools’ team.
  • Write effective legal incident reports.
  • Investigate criminal offenses occurring within district’s jurisdiction when authorized by administration.
  • Compile, maintain, and file all physical and computerized reports, records, and documents required, including affidavits for arrest, incident reports, and activity reports.
  • Turn in all current certifications and training certificates to human resources and continue to send completions of trainings to HR throughout the year.

Security and Parking

  • Register student vehicles and maintain accurate records of registration.
  • Work cooperatively with office personnel to inform students of problems with vehicles (i.e., improperly parked, lights on, etc.)
  • Assist law enforcement personnel as needed.
  • Give directions or act as a guide to authorized visitors.
  • Notify police, fire department, or other appropriate authority of any situation requiring immediate attention.
  • Operate all equipment including firearms according to established safety procedures.
  • Maintain and secure weapons at all times.
  • Follow district safety protocols and emergency procedures.

Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Mental Demands/Physical Demands/Environmental Factors

Tools/Equipment Used: District vehicle, two-way radio, alarm system and other security equipment, fire extinguisher, and standard office equipment including computer and peripherals.

Posture: Prolonged sitting and standing

Motion: Strenuous walking and climbing stairs; occasional keyboarding and use of mouse, moderate driving Lifting: Moderate lifting and carrying (15-44 pounds)

Environment: Work inside and outside (moderate exposure to sun, heat, cold, and inclement weather); moderate exposure to noise and vehicle exhaust; frequent districtwide travel

Other: Specific hearing and visual requirements; may be subject to adverse and hazardous working conditions, including violent and armed confrontations; ability to control sudden violent or extreme physical acts of others and exhibit rapid mental and muscular coordination simultaneously

Mental Demands: Maintain emotional control under stress; prolonged hours; on call 24 hours a day

jobs.title: Warehouse Stock Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Maintain a safe workplace by adhering to all safety policies and guidelines.
  • Join safety training meetings to improve your competence in handling tasks swiftly in a warehouse setting.
  • Organize, transfer, and distribute products to both stores and individuals.
  • Ensure the meticulous handling of goods for store shipment and guest drop-offs.
  • Streamline inventory movement and proficiently manage freight within the warehouse.
  • Keep your work area clean, organized, and free from any unnecessary mess.
  • Arrive at work on time and ensure that tasks are executed with precision and according to the established schedule.
  • Play a role in problem-solving endeavors to sustain operational enhancements.
  • Illustrate a beneficial and courteous manner when working by yourself or in a group.

Requirements:

  • Able to frequently lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Capacity to maintain an upright position, move about, exert pressure, pull, crouch, flex, and stretch during shifts.
  • Retain a constructive and professional mindset during teamwork or individual assignments.
  • Essential numerical proficiencies, such as counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Proficient in understanding and interpreting labels, tickets, and other forms of product documentation correctly.
  • Independently manage computer systems or handheld devices with minimal supervision once adequately trained.
  • Effective communication through speech and writing.
  • Aptitude in understanding, verbally expressing, and interpreting English to heed safety guidelines, policies, and instructions.

Additional Requirements:

  • Proficient in receiving education and operating motorized machinery responsibly (such as Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).
  • Skilled in working effectively at heights up to 40 feet when the situation demands.
  • Skilled in working for extended periods in temperature-regulated settings, which may include refrigeration and freezing conditions.

Benefits:

Target team members may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, subject to plan terms and employment eligibility. Employees also receive a 10% Target discount, plus an extra 20% off select wellness products, including fruits, vegetables, healthy foods, activewear, and tobacco cessation products.

Note:

Based on business needs and role requirements within Warehouse Operations, candidates may be considered for either a Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate position. The specific job responsibilities for each role are outlined in the application process.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Logistics Associate are essential to Frito-Lay's warehouse and distribution operations, helping ensure products move safely and efficiently from receiving through shipment. In this role, you'll support inventory management, order fulfillment, and product movement while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and productivity. If you enjoy hands-on work in a fast-paced environment and take pride in delivering accurate results, this position offers an opportunity to be part of a team that keeps our supply chain running smoothly.

What You'll Do

  • Receive inbound shipments and unload products, pallets, and materials from trailers and delivery vehicles.

  • Pick, stage, and prepare customer orders for shipping in accordance with established warehouse procedures.

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other powered warehouse equipment after completing required training and certification.

  • Move, organize, and store inventory using proper material-handling techniques and product rotation practices.

  • Verify product counts, labels, and shipping documentation to maintain inventory accuracy.

  • Assist with inventory audits, replenishment activities, and warehouse organization initiatives.

  • Build, secure, and prepare pallets to support safe transportation and product quality.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free work environment by performing routine housekeeping duties.

  • Follow all safety regulations, food safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.

  • Work closely with warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation teams to achieve daily operational and customer service objectives.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and move products throughout the workday.

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform repetitive physical tasks during extended shifts.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures and work instructions.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-oriented environment.

  • Previous experience in warehouse operations, logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or material handling is helpful but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse work throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment with varying temperatures, warehouse equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial equipment while complying with company safety standards.

Skills & Competencies

  • Safety-first approach

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Dependability and accountability

  • Attention to detail and inventory accuracy

  • Time management and organization

  • Critical thinking and problem-solving

  • Ability to succeed in a fast-paced warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse team members to support the movement of products across its distribution network. As a Logistics Associate, you'll play an important role in receiving, storing, and shipping products while helping maintain efficient operations and delivering the quality and service our customers expect every day.

Q: What is the difference between a Route Sales Representative and a warehouse role?

A: Route Sales Representatives visit stores, manage inventory, stock products, and maintain customer relationships. Warehouse employees focus on receiving, organizing, picking, packing, and preparing products for distribution.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q:What does a Frito-Lay warehouse worker do?
A: Warehouse workers load/unload trucks, pick and stack pallets, operate forklifts, and manage inventory of chips and snack products. It's physically active work involving standing, lifting, and moving product through the facility.

Q:How long is a seasonal shift?
A: Typically 8-hour shifts, similar to regular part-time or full-time roles, though hours can vary by employer and season (e.g., holidays vs. summer).

jobs.description:
Job Description

Distribution Center Associate are an important part of the Frito-Lay team, helping keep products moving safely and efficiently throughout our warehouse and distribution network. In this role, you'll receive, store, organize, and transport products while supporting daily warehouse operations and preparing orders for customer delivery. Your work helps ensure inventory accuracy, operational efficiency, and the timely distribution of our products.

We're looking for reliable individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, take pride in delivering quality work, and are committed to maintaining a safe workplace while supporting their team.

Responsibilities

  • Receive, unload, and move products, pallets, and materials throughout warehouse and shipping areas.

  • Pick, pack, stage, and prepare customer orders according to established procedures and delivery schedules.

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment after successfully completing required training and certification.

  • Store and transport products using proper handling techniques while following inventory rotation and storage guidelines.

  • Confirm product quantities, labels, and shipment documentation to help maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Support inventory management by assisting with cycle counts, stock replenishment, and product organization.

  • Assemble, wrap, and prepare pallets to ensure products are secure and ready for shipment.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by completing routine housekeeping and sanitation responsibilities.

  • Follow all company safety policies, food safety standards, and warehouse operating procedures.

  • Collaborate with warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation teams to meet productivity, shipping, and customer service goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Available to work flexible schedules, including weekends, holidays, overtime, and varying shifts based on business needs.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, and pull warehouse materials throughout the workday.

  • Capable of standing, walking, bending, reaching, climbing, kneeling, and performing repetitive physical activities for extended periods.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

  • Previous experience in warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or material handling is preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse duties throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment with changing temperatures, moderate to high noise levels, and active warehouse equipment.

  • Safely operate material-handling equipment while complying with all workplace safety requirements.

Skills & Competencies

  • Safety-focused mindset

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Reliability and consistent attendance

  • Accurate product handling and inventory control

  • Effective time management and organization

  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities

  • Ability to perform efficiently in a fast-paced warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse professionals to keep our supply chain moving. As a Distribution Center Associate, you'll play a key role in ensuring products are received, stored, prepared, and shipped accurately, helping deliver the quality snacks our customers expect while supporting safe and efficient warehouse operations.

Q: What is the difference between a Route Sales Representative and a warehouse role?

A: Route Sales Representatives visit stores, manage inventory, stock products, and maintain customer relationships. Warehouse employees focus on receiving, organizing, picking, packing, and preparing products for distribution.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q: How physically demanding are Frito-Lay production jobs?

A: Production and warehouse positions can be physically demanding and may involve prolonged standing, repetitive movements, lifting, bending, and working extended shifts. Employees are also expected to follow strict workplace safety procedures.

Q:How often do Frito-Lay employees get paid?
A: Most reviews indicate Frito-Lay pays weekly.

Job Description

Job Description

TPWD MISSION

To manage and conserve the natural and cultural resources of Texas and to provide hunting, fishing and outdoor recreation opportunities for the use and enjoyment of present and future generations.

HIRING CONTACT: Captain Luis Canales, (254) 784-9635

PHYSICAL WORK ADDRESS: TPWD Headquarters, 4200 Smith School Road, Austin, TX 78744

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

Under the direction of the Headquarters (HQ) Police Captain, this position performs complex (Journey-level) II or highly complex (senior-level) III security enforcement work including ensuring the safety of Texas Parks & Wildlife Department (TPWD) employees and the public, government officials and dignitaries visiting the TPWD Headquarters. Monitors and authorizes entrance and departures of employees and visitors, to include deliveries. Patrols buildings and grounds to maintain safety and security. Works under limited supervision, with moderate (II) or considerable (III) latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. Performs additional duties as assigned. Complies with all Agency, Division and Branch rules, regulations and procedures.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

Graduation from High School or GED.

Experience:

SO II: One year of experience in law enforcement, security work, or a closely related field (educational or customer service).

SO III: Four years of experience in law enforcement, security work, or a closely related field (educational or customer service).

Licensure:

Applicant must possess a valid State driver's license.

Physical Requirements:

Applicants must be:

(a) pass annual physical readiness testing required at a 25% standard for initial and continued employment;

(b) of high moral character and hold no felony convictions, no DWI, BWI, DUID or class A misdemeanor convictions within the past five years, no Class B misdemeanor convictions within the past two years- a background check will be completed;

(c) the recipient of an honorable discharge from the military service, if applicable;

(d) Twenty-one years of age older. A background check will be done prior to final employment approval.

NOTE: Retention of position contingent upon obtaining and maintaining physical requirements and required licenses/certifications.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

Security officer training approved by Department of Public Safety, or comparable from other state.

Experience:

Experience as a licensed peace officer or security officer.

Experience with customer service work.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

SO II-III

Knowledge of Texas Criminal Laws, the Code of Criminal Procedures and the Penal Code;

Knowledge of emergency reporting procedures and traffic and parking regulations;

Knowledge of safety and security procedures;

SO II:

Skill in using MS Word, Excel and Outlook;

Skill in effective verbal and written communication;

Skill in monitoring and assessing situations, determining appropriate response, using emergency law enforcement equipment;

Skill in effective interaction with staff at all levels of the department and other State agencies and organizations;

Skill in providing quality customer service in a courteous and professional manner;

SO III:

Skills of SO II; PLUS:

Skill in operating a security control center;

SO II-III

Ability to enforce security rules and regulations;

Ability to conduct investigations;

Ability to under stressful situations;

Ability to work independently with little or no supervision;

Ability to work as a member of a team;

Ability to perform manual labor, including lifting supplies and materials up to 50 lbs.;

Ability to conduct work activities in accordance with TPWD safety program.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Required to work 40 hours per week, includes various schedules with hours other than 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and days off other than Saturdays, Sundays and holidays;

Required to work overtime as necessary;

Required to perform work outdoors, occasionally in adverse weather conditions;

Required to perform manual labor, including lifting supplies and materials up to 50 lbs.;

Required to travel 5% with possible overnight stays;

Required to operate a State vehicle;

Must conform to TPWD dress and grooming standards, work rules and safety procedures;

Non-smoking environment in State buildings and vehicles.

PLEASE NOTE:

All applications must include complete job history information for each period of employment, provided either in the WORK HISTORY SECTION or in the attached RÉSUMÉ. Please ensure each entry includes:
  • Job title,
  • Employer name,
  • Dates of employment (month/year),
  • If employment is less than full-time status, indicate part-time in the work history section or résumé, and
  • Description of duties performed.
    NOTE: Volunteer experience may be counted toward required experience.

IMPORTANT:
  • College Transcripts: If education is used to meet the minimum qualifications, a copy of the college transcript(s) issued by the registrar must be provided at the time of interview (unless otherwise noted in the posting).
  • "N/A" may be entered in fields that are not applicable.
  • Omission of required information may result in disqualification.

Work In Texas (WIT) Applicants:
  • WIT applicants must complete the supplemental questions in the CAPPS Candidate Gateway to be considered.
  • To complete these questions, log in to CAPPS Candidate Gateway .
  • If you need assistance creating a résumé, please refer to the "Create a Résumé" link for Job Seekers on the Work In Texas website .

If the required information and attachments are not submitted as noted above, your application will be considered incomplete.

EXCELLENT BENEFITS:

Texas Parks and Wildlife offers a variety of benefits for employees such as generous paid time off, group insurance, retirement and pension, and frequent training and staff development opportunities. Other benefits include longevity pay, merit pay, deferred compensation, flexible benefit plans, 401K/457 retirement plans, direct deposit, staggered work hours, Employee Assistance Program and a Return-to-Work Program. For new employees or rehires, health insurance is available on the 1st of the following month after a 60-day waiting period. Click HERE to view our Benefits page.

jobs.title: Security Officer Armed - Security
jobs.description:
Summary:

Uniformed position at all times. Armed Security Officer's duties include being a visible deterrent to criminal activity, providing security for patients, Associates, and visitors, protecting and patrolling hospital buildings, assets and premises as assigned. The Armed Security Officer is responsible for responding to all emergency codes, internal/external disaster events as needed and/or requested, conducting preliminary investigations of reported incidents, and performing other security related tasks as directed by a security supervisor/and or Manager. The Armed Security Officer must have flexibility in hours and be able to rotate between facilities including travel whenever necessary. CHRISTUS Approved uniforms must be worn in accordance with dress code requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Meets expectations of the applicable OneCHRISTUS Competencies: Leader of Self, Leader of Others, or Leader of Leaders.
  • Conducts frequent security patrols of the facilities and grounds as assigned.
  • Identifies and reports trends related to security issues. Recommends actions.
  • Takes initial information for an incident report, uses proper grammar, spelling, punctuation, notes only the facts, leaving out personal opinions and submits report in a timely manner (no later than the end of assigned shift).
  • Responds promptly to all service requests relayed by supervisor, telephone, pass-on, e-mail, radio, cell phone and other correspondence in a courteous and expeditious manner.
  • Responds to the collection, inventory and return of lost and found items, patient valuables, and personal property according to policy.
  • Enforces all rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of CHRISTUS Health and the laws of the state in which CHRISTUS is doing business.
  • Controls and enforces facility parking using patrols, violation warning citations, towing, booting and explanation of rules as applicable.
  • Assists clinical/non-clinical Associates with combative patients or visitors.
  • Demonstrates competence to perform assigned client care responsibilities in a way that meets the age-specific and developmental needs of persons served by the department.
  • Demonstrates proficiency and knowledge in the operation of the Attendant Console, Paging System, security radio/dispatch system, operations of the Digital Video Recorder (NVR) security monitors (CCTV) and the general overhead paging system.
  • Must be proficient with the use of a PC to generate electronic daily activity security reports, incident reports, emails and other applicable electronic correspondence during the performance of duties.
  • Promotes a safe environment by reporting safety hazards observed (broken water/sprinkler lines, burned out internal/external lighting, smoke/gas odors, tripping hazards, etc.) during the performance of security rounds.
  • Appropriately adapts assigned client assessment, treatment and/or care methods to accommodate the physical, cultural, age-specific, and other developmental needs of each person served.
  • Demonstrated competence with handgun, hand cuffs, baton, non-crisis intervention certification and two-way radios.
  • Frequent exposure to aggressive behavior and emotionally charged situations.
  • Occasional exposure to hazardous conditions such as fires, chemical spills, and flooding.
  • Frequent exposure to heat and cold from external weather conditions.
  • Long periods of walking, standing, stooping, and lifting.
  • Must be physically fit and able to walk all areas of the facilities and grounds, to restrain those who need restraint and be able to assist nursing staff with lifting patients of all sizes.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Must be always mentally alert.
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be able to make immediate decisions regarding laws, policies, and procedures.
  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks and prioritize.
  • Must be able to handle personal stress and possible violence.

Job Requirements:

Education/Skills

  • High School Diploma or its equivalent required

Experience

  • Minimum two (2) years of armed security experience (may substituted by Honorable Military Service) preferred
  • Law enforcement experience preferred
  • Healthcare security experience preferred

Licenses, Registrations, or Certifications

  • Verbal De-escalation training must be completed within 60 days of hire

  • BLS required within 60 days of hire

  • Expandable Baton training, defensive tactics training, firearms training, weapon qualification, and firearms retention training must be completed prior to letter of authorization to carry is issued

  • Successful completion of all pre-employment and post offer assessments to include the Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Inventory -2 (MMPI-2-RF-PCIR); the California Psychological Inventory (CPI); the Police and Public Safety Selection Report (PPSSR); the Personal Experience Inventory (PEI) and a clinical interview by a third personal psychologist

  • Will be required to take random drug test screening

  • Valid Driver's license required

  • Candidates must maintain an acceptable driving record to meet CHRISTUS Health standards for positions requiring driving. An unacceptable record includes, but is not limited to:

  • One or more moving violations within a 12-month period.

  • One or more chargeable accidents within a 12-month period. Chargeable means the driver is determined to be the primary cause of the accident.

  • Contributing factors such as weather or mechanical issues will be considered.

  • Any combination of accidents and/or moving violations.

  • Violations include any ticket, charge, or other law enforcement proceeding related to these, as well as independent evidence of violations deemed relevant by CHRISTUS Health Security.

  • For Texas positions:

  • Must hold an active Level 3 Commission with the Texas Department of Public Safety Private Security Bureau (TDPSPSB).

  • New hires who have completed the TDPSPSB security commission course must obtain their commission prior to hire.

  • If the license status is ACTIVE in TOPS and the pocket card has not yet been received, the licensee may begin working.

  • Until the pocket card is received, the licensee must carry proof of ACTIVE status (e.g., screenshot or printed copy from TOPS) while on duty.

  • For New Mexico positions:

  • Officers may not carry a weapon on duty until completing 40 hours of training and receiving a letter of authorization from the CHRISTUS Vice President of Security to carry a CHRISTUS Health-assigned weapon.

  • For Louisiana positions:

  • Officers may not carry a weapon on duty until completing 40 hours of training and receiving a letter of authorization from the CHRISTUS Vice President of Security to carry a CHRISTUS Health-assigned weapon.

In accordance with the CHRISTUS Health License, Certification and Registration Verification Policy, all Associates are required to obtain the required certifications for their respective positions within the designated time frame.

Work Schedule:

6AM - 6PM 12 HR Shift

Work Type:

Full Time

control procedures.

access concerns.

situations.

  • Authorized to work in the United States without employer

sponsorship.

  • Previous security, law enforcement, campus safety, or military

experience.

  • This position is based on Moody Bible Institute\'s downtown Chicago

campus and includes both outdoor and indoor responsibilities.

  • Officers regularly patrol campus on foot and in vehicles, respond to

emergencies, and interact with a diverse campus community.

  • The role requires standing, walking, climbing stairs, and working in

varying weather conditions.

**Schedule**

This position follows an overnight shift schedule, consisting of three

12-hour shifts (6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m.) per week, with a rotating fourth

weekend shift as needed.

jobs.title: Security Operations Performance Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview
We are seeking a confident, experienced, and dedicated professional to help lead and manage our Security Operations Department. The Security Operations Performance Coordinator (SOPC) will be assisting with the oversight and coordination of security operations and the scheduling of security personnel across various security post sites. Your proactive approach will help foster a secure environment, empowering our teams to operate confidently, effectively, and professionally. This role focuses on maintaining seamless staffing, security officer responsibilities, performance, regulatory compliance, and client relationships. ($46.5K - 55K+)

Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Relationship and Management: Cultivating strong relationships by serving as a primary interface with Senior Management, Scheduling Staff, security personnel, and clients.
  • Site Management: Conducting regular site visits, ensuring post sites are properly maintained, staffed, secured, and addressing security issues in a timely and appropriate manner. Documenting deficiencies noted during site visits and following up with Senior Management. Providing Senior Management and clients with documentation of corrective actions taken, reports, and follow-up measures.
  • Leadership and Management: Monitoring and analyzing security operations performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement strategic enhancements
  • Developing and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensuring compliance.
  • Making quality decisions, processing critical incidents, coordinating with onsite management and offsite response with security teams, facilities, emergency services, clients, and Senior Management.
  • Manage incident reporting processes, documenting events clearly and accurately for review and follow-up.
  • Personnel Accountability & Training: Ensuring security officers meet required performance standards, which involves:
  • Maintaining punctuality.
  • Adhering to uniform and gear requirements.
  • Completing scheduled tours.
  • Submitting accurate and detailed reports.
  • Enforcing consistent use and training on mobile applications for security personnel's time and attendance recording in the field.
  • Providing necessary or recurring training for security personnel.
  • Addressing security officer infractions/concerns and providing corrective and/or disciplinary measures.
  • Ensuring strict compliance with post orders, private security, federal, state, and municipal laws and regulations, retraining mandates, and licensing requirements.
  • Talent and Customer Management:Driving client satisfaction and retention by building a reliable team of qualified security personnel for assignments, maintaining standards, assuring compliance with policies and procedures, and proactively managing customer relationships.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in management and operations within security, law enforcement, military, or related industries is required, with a preference for candidates who have effectively and efficiently supervised and managed, leading by example.
  • Thorough comprehension of Texas private security statutes, in addition to federal, state, and municipal laws and regulations, is required.
  • Must have an active State of Texas Commissioned Security License (Level III) or higher, OC Spray Certification, and supervisor/management training.
  • A minimum of 3 years of proven experience in Client Relationships.
  • Associate's degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Emergency Management, or a related field (Bachelor’s degree preferred).
  • A high degree of self-motivation (self-starter), a proactive approach, and effective problem-solving abilities.
  • Required ability to adjust schedules regularly and work hours necessary to meet all operational demands.
  • The ability to maintain composure and professional conduct when interacting with executives, clients, staff, authorities, and the public.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to effectively multitask.
  • Able to speak and write English clearly to effectively communicate with the public, clients, and direct personnel.
  • Standard computer/technology proficiency (Microsoft Suites, Google Docs, etc.).
  • Must be 18 years of age or older, and have the legal right to work in the United States.
  • Must have and provide a clean driving record immediately upon hire.
  • Must be willing to participate in the Company’s pre-employment screening process, including drug screening and background investigation.
  • Have unwavering ethical standards and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

Pay: $46,500.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule
  • Paid time off
  • Referral program

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
MD Anderson Cancer Center is a leading institution focused on cancer care, research, education, and prevention. As a Public Safety Officer, you will help ensure a safe and welcoming environment so patients, families, and employees can focus on care, research, and education. Public Safety Officers are essential to maintaining security and supporting the mission of MD Anderson Cancer Center.

The ideal candidate will have a high school diploma or equivalent, one year of relevant work experience, and a valid Texas driver's license. Preferred qualifications include International Association for Healthcare Security and Safety (IAHSS) certification. Candidates should demonstrate strong communication skills, sound judgment under pressure, and a commitment to public safety.

Minimum $18.00 - Midpoint $20.54 - Maximum $23.08 per hour based on a 40-hour work week. This is a full-time position with rotating shifts that may include days, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. The primary work location is the MD Anderson Cancer Center campus in the Texas Medical Center.

Why Us?

Join a mission-driven team where your work directly supports patient care and safety. MD Anderson offers competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth and specialized training in healthcare security.

  • Employer-paid medical coverage starting day one for employees working 30+ hours/week, plus optional group dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Accruals for PTO and Extended Illness Bank, plus paid holidays, wellness, childcare, and other leave options.
  • Tuition Assistance Program after six months of service and access to extensive wellness, fitness, and employee resource groups.
  • Defined-benefit pension through the Teachers Retirement System, voluntary retirement plans, and employer-paid life and reduced salary protection programs.

Responsibilities

  • Provide information, directions, and assistance to patients, visitors, and staff
  • Patrol campus by vehicle and on foot to monitor for suspicious activity and safety hazards
  • Enforce institutional and parking regulations; issue permits and citations as needed
  • Serve as a Campus Security Authority in compliance with the Clery Act
  • Respond to emergencies and maintain calm, professional judgment under pressure
  • Support institutional policies and ensure a safe environment for all individuals on campus

jobs.title: Security Officer Full Time - Reception
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Full Time - Reception in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Residential, and more. As a Front Desk Security Professional at a residential location, you will welcome residents and guests, manage access control, monitor activity, and provide outstanding customer service. You will serve as a visible, approachable presence, communicate clearly with residents and staff, and help address security-related concerns. Join Allied Universal’s caring, team-oriented culture, where integrity, reliability, and innovation guide the work we do.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $17.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon12:00 AM - 08:00 AMTue12:00 AM - 08:00 AMWed12:00 AM - 08:00 AMThur12:00 AM - 08:00 AMFri12:00 AM - 08:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to residents, visitors, and/or vendors at a residential front desk by carrying out site-specific procedures and security-related policies.
  • Monitor access to the property, greet and screen visitors, verify authorization as required, and maintain visitor and vendor logs.
  • Receive calls, deliveries, and resident inquiries; provide directions and communicate concerns to appropriate property personnel.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following emergency response procedures.
  • Monitor front desk activity and access control systems, document security-related observations, and report unusual activity to appropriate personnel.

Minimum Requirements

  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • CPR/First Aid certification is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • A Guard Card/License is preferred.
  • Access control/badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.
