jobs.title: Access Control Officer - Poly (TX CONST)
jobs.description:
Description

Job Summary:
The Access Control Officer will be responsible for ensuring the protection and security of sensitive facilities, assets, and information by controlling access to restricted areas and enforcing strict security protocols. The successful candidate will utilize their expertise and security clearance to monitor access points, verify personnel credentials, conduct screening for prohibited devices, escort non-cleared personnel and respond to security incidents as necessary. The Access Control Officer will play a critical role in maintaining a secure environment and upholding the highest level of confidentiality.

Responsibilities:
• Control access to designated facilities, sensitive areas, and classified information based on established security protocols and clearance levels.
• Verify personnel identification and clearances to ensure only authorized individuals are granted entry.
• Operate and manage access control systems, biometric devices, and other security technologies to facilitate smooth and secure access procedures.
• Monitor security cameras, alarm systems, and surveillance equipment to detect and prevent security breaches or unauthorized activities.
• Conduct screening for prohibited devices of client and vendor employees at established screening checkpoints .
• Act as escort of visitors to sensitive areas during construction, maintenance and other critical work tasks.
• Assist in the evacuation of site personnel during training drills and actual emergencies which may include active shooter situations.
• Conduct periodic, proactive patrols (includes walking and climbing stairs) to ensure the integrity of physical security barriers and adherence to access control procedures.
• Collaborate with security personnel, management, and government agencies to respond to and report security incidents and breaches promptly.
• Perform thorough and accurate documentation of access control activities, incidents, and security logs.
• Assist in the development and implementation of security measures to improve access control processes and protocols.
• Provide outstanding customer service by professionally interacting with personnel, visitors, and clients while maintaining security standards.
• Maintain strict confidentiality and professionalism when handling classified or sensitive information.
• Participate in security training programs to stay updated on industry best practices and procedures.
• Comply with all company policies, federal regulations, and security clearance requirements at all times.

Requirements

Qualifications:
  • Top-Secret security clearance with Polygraph.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must provide a valid U.S. Passport Book or Passport Card.
  • High school diploma or equivalent; additional relevant security certifications or training is a plus.
  • Proven experience as an Access Control Officer or in a related security role.
  • Must be able to stand and conduct screening activities with handheld detectors/devices for extended periods of time (up to 12 hours) - Please note that employees are given breaks
  • Must be able to conduct routine foot patrols (inside and out) in all weather conditions. In many instances by themselves. Patrols at many/most sites can take up to 2-hours to conduct/complete throughout an 8 to 12-hour shifts.
  • In-depth knowledge of access control systems, physical security protocols, and security technologies.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow precise security procedures.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with personnel, visitors, and clients professionally.
  • Must be able to handle stress associated with client/vendor interfaces and disputes regarding screening/wanding standards and able to enforce standard operating procedures to stop an entrant into the facilities from bringing prohibited items and materials into the workplace
  • Ability to work independently, make decisions under pressure, and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Flexibility to work various shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Ability to hold over their scheduled shift to maintain critical, minimum staffing levels if required.
  • Physical fitness and ability to perform periodic patrols and standing for extended periods.
  • Strong ethics, integrity, and commitment to maintaining a secure and confidential environment.
  • Ability to work in a high-level stress environment.

Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to walk 3-5 miles during shift
  • Ability to stand for 60 minutes at a time
  • Occasional climbing of ladders.
  • Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps.
  • Prolonged standing.
  • Occasional lifting 50lbs. / 22.5kg.
  • Occasional push or pull 50-75lbs. / 22.5-34kg. with assistive device.
  • *Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction).
  • *Normal color vision for electrical work.

*Normal is defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for assisting with the protection of property and assets, including employee through responding to Fire, medical, and other emergencies on campus; in addition to enforcing the polices as directed by management and/or employee handbook. This role is critical to maintaining the luxury standard and reputation of The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa while upholding the highest levels of discretion and professionalism.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
  • Physical patrols of the campus buildings garages and surface lots
  • Directing traffic as needed on campus
  • Responding to Fire, medical and other emergencies on campus
  • Maintenance of the Guest Room Safes, Golf cart and other Loss Prevention equipment
  • Maintenance of First Aid Equipment, including all kits and Automatic External Defibrillators
KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
  • High school education, GED, or equivalent experience
  • Must have 1-4 years previous security experience
  • Must have proficient technology skills with POS systems

LICENSES AND/OR CERTIFICATIONS

PHYSICAL JOB REQUIREMENTS
Must be able to meet the following minimum physical requirements for at least an eight-hour shift:
  • Physical Stamina: Frequent standing, walking, climbing of ladders and stairs, kneeling, reaching overhead, lifting and carrying various objects weighing up to 30 lbs. Must be able to work safely and effectively in outdoor temperatures. Summer temperatures outside can get above 95 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 months of year. For 2 months of year, low temperatures can get below 20 degrees Fahrenheit. Must be able to swim.
  • Hearing / Speech: Must be able to effectively engage in one-on-one communication with guests, members, and customers and use a 2-way radio to communicate clearly and accurately with co-workers.

  • Literacy: Must be able to produce, read and understand reports, including security, incident and police reports. Must be able to analyze and process written information from a variety of sources and effectively communicate content of reports.
  • Chemicals/Agents: Must be able to work safely with chemicals according to SDS sheets and all applicable laws, codes and regulatory requirements.

Your role at Clorox:

The purpose of this position is to lead and carry out all daily business-related activities associated with general plant operations and to act as the liaison between the hourly work force and management, and to provide innovative and sound tactical thinking to achieve the appropriate levels of operating performance.

jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Allied Universal® is hiring a Security Professional Flex Officer. The Security Professional Flex Officer will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Healthcare, Education, Finance and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Security Professional Flex Officer, you’ll use our exclusive shift-pickup platform to view and claim open shifts based on your availability - giving you the freedom to build a schedule that works for you, while gaining valuable site experience across various industries. Whether you're looking to supplement your income or take the first step toward a phenomenal career, this position offers unmatched access to hands-on experience and growth opportunities. The Security Professional Flex Officer may be called upon to work irregular shifts at times with little to no advance notice.

Responsibilities

  • Perform security patrols of designated areas on foot or in vehicle
  • Watch for irregular or unusual conditions that may create security concerns or safety hazards
  • Sound alarms or calls police or fire department in case of fire or presence of unauthorized persons
  • Warn violators of rule infractions, such as loitering, smoking, or carrying forbidden articles
  • Permit authorized persons to enter property and monitors entrances and exits
  • Observe departing personnel to protect against theft of company property and ensures that authorized removal of property is conducted within appropriate client requirements
  • Investigate and prepare reports on accidents, incidents, and suspicious activities; maintain written logs as required by the post
  • Aid customers, employees, and visitors in a courteous and professional manner
  • Make emergency notifications as necessary pursuant to site Post Orders

Qualifications (must Have)

  • Must possess a high school diploma or equivalent or 5 years of verifiable experience
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
  • Valid driver’s license if driving a company or customer-owned vehicle
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws; Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law
  • No prior experience required
  • Be at least 18 years of age, or higher if required by the state (21 years, if armed)
  • Reliability and ability to adapt to different post assignments
  • Be able to operate radio or telephone equipment and/or console monitors
  • Demonstrated ability to interact cordially and communicate with the public
  • Effective oral and written communication skills; able to write informatively, clearly, and accurately
  • Active listening and problem-solving skills
  • Assess and evaluate situations effectively; identify critical issues quickly and accurately
  • Mediate conflict with tact, diplomacy
  • Teamwork
  • Attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)

  • Ability to speak, read, and write in multiple languages (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, French, Arabic)
  • Prior security, military, or law enforcement experience

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • Company's retirement plans
  • Seven holidays annually paid at time and a half, if worked
  • 40 hours of vacation after one year of employment at eligible work assignments; unused vacation is only paid out where required by law

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

About UPS & Our Culture

Most warehouse employers demand experience before they will even interview you. UPS is different. We hire driven, motivated people and train them to be exceptional — no prior warehouse experience required, no resume full of logistics jobs needed. Our overnight sort shift is the single best entry point into a UPS career for first-time warehouse workers, career changers, and anyone who has never worked in a distribution center before. When you search for no experience warehouse jobs, you will not find a better starting line than a UPS overnight shift. We offer real Teamsters union wages, real medical benefits, and the kind of paid training that turns complete beginners into skilled operators within weeks.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I had zero warehouse experience when I applied. I had been working retail and wanted something with better pay and real benefits. UPS hired me on the spot, trained me completely on my first shift, and within thirty days I was one of the faster sorters in my area. The overnight differential on top of the union wage is more money than I made at my retail job working twice the hours. If you are searching for no experience warehouse jobs near me, stop looking — this is the one." - Current Overnight Warehouse Associate, Las Vegas, NV.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Overnight Warehouse Associate with no prior experience needed, you will be fully trained on your first shift and supported by experienced team leads throughout your entire qualification period inside our package center. Overnight shifts typically run 10:30 PM to 3:30 AM, leaving your entire day free.

  • Paid On-The-Job Training: From your very first shift, a UPS-certified on-job trainer walks beside you, demonstrating every method step by step — no prior experience required, no knowledge assumed, no worker left to figure it out alone.
  • Package Sorting & Loading: Learn to read destination routing labels and sort packages onto the correct outbound belts and package cars, building speed and accuracy with each shift until you hit full production rate within your qualification window.
  • Safety Method Mastery: UPS's injury-prevention training is among the most comprehensive in the industry — your trainer teaches proper lifting, lowering, and equipment interaction techniques before you handle a single package unsupervised.

Benefits & Perks

No experience is required to access UPS's full benefit package — medical, dental, and vision coverage through the Teamsters union, a defined-benefit pension plan, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program worth up to $25,000. The overnight shift differential adds significant income on top of the base union wage. Your days remain completely free. Weekly paychecks start from your very first week on the job.

  • Able to work well with others, self-motivated, and capable of working independently with little supervision

  • Work in a cold/wet storage facility environment (ranging from -10 (freezer) to 55 degrees Fahrenheit). General warehouse temps 34-46 degrees, Freezer -10 degrees

jobs.description:
NOW HIRING — COMMISSIONED SECURITY OFFICERS | Greater Austin

Starting at $23/hour | Full-Time + Overtime | Outdoor Foot Patrol

Ranger Protection Agency isn't looking for officers to sit in a vehicle and observe from a distance. We are a “Boots on the Ground — Resolve & Report” private security agency looking for qualified, like-minded professionals who are comfortable being proactive and handling issues on property.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Only applicants who meet ALL of the following will be considered at this time:

  • Current Texas Level III (Armed) Commissioned Security Officer License
  • Own firearm and at least one less-lethal option (O/C, baton, or Taser) with appropriate training/certification
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable personal vehicle
  • Currently live and/or work in the Greater Austin area
  • Able to pass a drug test

THE POSITION

These are outdoor foot-patrol positions at apartment communities and retail centers in the greater Austin area.

Our officers do more than observe and report. Ranger's Resolve & Report approach includes:

  • Addressing lease violations
  • Issuing Criminal Trespass Warnings
  • Utilizing lawful arrest authority when appropriate
  • Proactively addressing suspicious or criminal activity
  • Maintaining a visible security presence and interacting with residents, management, and law enforcement

For individuals interested in pursuing a career in law enforcement, Ranger provides an opportunity to gain relevant, hands-on field experience while developing communication, documentation, de-escalation, decision-making, and enforcement skills.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Starting at $23/hour

  • Full-time positions
  • Set weekly schedule
  • Bi-weekly pay
  • Subsidized health insurance
  • Accrued Paid Time Off
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee discounts
  • Professional development assistance
  • Training and advancement opportunities

If you're looking for a security job where getting out, engaging, problem-solving, and making a difference on the properties you protect is the rule—not the exception—we want to hear from you.

Ranger Protection Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Security Shift Supervisors - Part Time
jobs.description:
We are hiring Part Time Shift Supervisor to work at two Out Door Public Venues in the Downtown Loop area of Chicago. Ideal candidates must be available to work all shifts and must be available to work weekends. Hours are 1pm-9pm, 2pm-10pm or 3pm-11pm Friday/Saturday and Sunday

Responsibilities:

  • Help supervise operations of an assigned Client site on assigned shift.
  • Report directly to Site Supervisor/Director and/or Marksman / Titan Management.
  • Manage a team of security officers, including participating in scheduling, payroll, training, coaching, development and support.
  • Ensure the Client Site is provided with high quality security services to protect people and property.
  • Handle all escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately.
  • Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, recognition, etc.).
  • Provide the basis of a great work environment by treating staff with respect.
  • Assist in the Coordination and/or conduct site-specific "on the job training", client-specific training and annual refresher training for staff by adhering to Titan's training standards.
  • Reconcile logs, shift responsibilities and patrols; review incident reports prior to submitting to Site Supervisor and/or Director and coordinate preliminary investigations.
  • Develop/maintain operational procedures and post orders that are always available for emergency reference by staff.
  • Train and qualify to work assigned post. Understands the specific and general post instructions for that assigned post. Maintain practical knowledge of all additional and emergency post instructions that are called for by the client.
  • Maintain access control procedures set by building management.
  • Effectively utilize access control systems, visitor management systems and CCTV systems as needed.
  • Identify all tenants and/or visitors upon arrival.
  • Ensure visitors and vendors are properly signed in prior to accessing the building.
  • Observe departing personnel to guard against theft of tenant or building property.
  • Monitor security cameras that are within the facility.
  • Respond to incidents including property emergencies.
  • Conduct general patrols of the entire property during various hours, if required, including numerous flights of stairs and frequent patrols of the exterior in any weather conditions.
  • Ability to stand/sit/walk for extended periods of time.
  • Assist tenants and visitors with directions and general business information.
  • Clearly and accurately record data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, and malfunctioning of equipment, to building and Titan management.
  • Maintain clear, accurate logs pertaining to people or property including packages.
  • Provide excellent Customer Service to all parties encountered while on duty.
  • Other duties as assigned.

***These positions require at least 1 year of continuous supervisory experience.***

Qualifications

Education and/or Experience: High School diploma or general education degree (GED) and 3 years prior satisfactory employment as a security officer or directly related experience. Must be at least 18 years of age.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Valid Security License if required by state, driver's license as applicable.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Bi-lingual considered a plus.

Other Qualifications: Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check. Must maintain a working telephone number though which we can contact you.

Physical Demands: The physical demands are based on the contract and must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. A list of these job duties is inclusive of, but not limited to: candidates must be able to stand for extended periods of time; be able to lift, push, and/or pull at least 50 lbs.; be able to accommodate foot patrols on the interior & exterior of the assigned facility; be able to perform assigned duties regardless of inclement weather.

Pay and Benefits of Security Supervisors:
$22.60 / hour

Paid time off and paid holidays
Medical and Dental insurance
Opportunities for career growth and promotion
Skills-enhancing training

EOE/M/F/D/V

jobs.title: Event Security Officers – Level II & Level III
jobs.description:
We are seeking professional, dependable, and experienced security officers to support event operations alongside event staff, venue security, local law enforcement.

Positions Available

  • Level II Non-Commissioned Security Officers
  • Level III Commissioned Security Officers

Level II Non-Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level II Officers will provide professional, uniformed security support throughout the event. Officers will primarily be assigned to access-control, observation, guest-flow, and security-presence posts.

Responsibilities

  • Staff assigned security posts, including entrances, interior doorways, stairwells, corridors, registration areas, and other designated locations.
  • Maintain a professional and visible security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for unauthorized access, disturbances, suspicious activity, safety concerns, or violations of event policies.
  • Assist with orderly guest movement and crowd flow.
  • Provide basic directions and assistance to guests when appropriate.
  • Report security incidents or concerns through the established chain of command.
  • Assist event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement personnel as directed.
  • Respond appropriately to disturbances, safety concerns, or medical incidents until relieved by emergency personnel.
  • Remain at your assigned post unless properly relieved or directed otherwise.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Important: Event personnel, not Level II officers, will have primary responsibility for validating invitations and checking guest identification.

Level II Requirements

  • Current Texas DPS Non-Commissioned Security Officer (Level II) license, or higher applicable Texas security license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation with RKSMS through the Texas Online Private Security system prior to the event.
  • Must have completed all required Texas training and licensing requirements.
  • Level II officers will not carry firearms while performing security duties.
  • Professional appearance and conduct.
  • Strong communication and situational-awareness skills.
  • Ability to remain standing and attentive for extended periods.

Level III Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level III Officers will provide armed security coverage at strategically designated locations throughout the event. Officers will supplement Level II personnel and support areas requiring an elevated security presence and rapid-response capability.

Responsibilities

  • Staff designated armed-security posts at higher-risk or strategically important locations.
  • Maintain a professional and highly visible armed-security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for threats, disturbances, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and safety concerns.
  • Provide immediate security response when directed by event leadership.
  • Assist with de-escalation and management of security incidents within the officer's authority and training.
  • Coordinate with event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement when necessary.
  • Maintain strict firearms safety, weapons-retention, and use-of-force discipline.
  • Remain at the assigned post unless properly relieved or redirected.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Level III Requirements

  • Current and active Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation prior to the event.
  • Completion of required Level III training, testing, and firearms qualification.
  • Must meet all applicable Texas DPS firearms requirements.
  • Must be qualified with the type/category of firearm authorized for use at the event.
  • Strong situational awareness, communication, and professional judgment.
  • Ability to remain attentive and professional in a large, high-profile event environment.

Ideal Candidates

We are looking for security professionals who are:

  • Licensed and in good standing with Texas DPS.
  • Reliable and punctual.
  • Professional and customer-service oriented.
  • Comfortable working in a large-scale event environment.
  • Able to follow post orders and the established chain of command.
  • Experienced with crowd management, access control, event security, or similar assignments.

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Armed Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Patrol Driver in Cleburne, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $18.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

How This Role Works

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.

jobs.title: School Safety and Security Site Lead
jobs.description:
Description: The School Safety and Security Site Lead is responsible for maintaining the overall safety, security, and physical integrity of the school campus during after-school hours, evening programs, and special events. This role is responsible for maintaining high situational awareness through active technology monitoring, physical patrols, and effective conflict de-escalation to ensure a secure environment for students, staff, and visitors. This is a part-time position (FTE 0.7).

The work calendar is attached. On student attendance days, the position works 3:00 pm - 9:00 pm. On non-student attendance days, the position works 8:00 am - 1:30 pm.

Job Summary

  • Surveillance and Patrol: Actively monitor campus security cameras, access control systems and conduct regular physical rounds of the building and grounds to ensure all areas are secure for extra-curricular activities.
  • Emergency Response and De-escalation: Lead the initiation and coordination of emergency response protocols in accordance with district crisis plans. Utilize verbal de-escalation techniques to resolve low-level conflicts or unauthorized presence on campus. This also includes responding immediately to address safety concerns and emergency situations.
  • Liaison Duties: Serve as the primary point of contact and liaison between first responders (police, fire, EMS) and school administration, particularly the School Safety and Emergency Preparedness Coordinator during after-hours incidents or emergencies.
  • Access Control and Visitor Management: Communicate safety information as needed when managing visitors. Verify authorized access for after-school facility rentals and community groups.
  • Safety Promotion: Promote a safe and professional school environment by observing and reporting any security vulnerabilities or safety hazards on school property.
  • Professionalism: Cultivate inclusive and equitable working relationships with staff and community members while maintaining strict confidentiality regarding safety and security matters.
  • Communication & Operations: Maintain continuous radio contact with event staff, custodians, and administration as needed. Track after-school program schedules and occupancy across the facility.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Provide regular verbal updates to the administration responsible for activities and athletics regarding security incidents, policy violations, or operational concerns that impact campus safety or facility maintenance. Written reports will be provided quarterly and as needed.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities

  • Ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with staff, visitors, and first responders.
  • Ability to exercise sound independent judgment and maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with school and district personnel and maintain organizational relationships.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with staff, visitors, and students.
  • Ability to walk, stand, and move quickly throughout a multi-story campus for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs.
  • Ability to sit at a monitoring station for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to describe problems and work orally or in writing to supervisor as needed.
  • Knowledge and experience with security software (camera systems and two-way radio equipment).
  • Demonstrate organization and time management skills.

Education/Certification/Qualifications Profile

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of prior experience in security, law enforcement, military, or school operations preferred.
  • Must hold a valid driver's license.
  • Must possess or be able to obtain a valid Red Cross First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)/AED Certificate or equivalent.
  • Must complete district-approved ALICE training.

EQUIPMENT: Use standard office equipment such as personal computers, printer, copier and fax machines and telephone. Use security specific technology.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work in a standard school building environment.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENT: No travel anticipated

SUPERVISOR: School Safety, Security and Emergency Preparedness Coordinator

JOB CATEGORY AND WORK CALENDAR: Non-Bargaining, Calendar 5600 (211 days). Hours on non-student attendance days would be different than hours on student attendance days.

FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt

RATE OF PAY: $23.00 - $36.18/hour

BENEFITS: Benefit information can be found here: Benefit Package 12 month non-exempt

SELECTION PROCEDURE: Qualified candidates will be contacted by the appropriate building administrator.

Immediate Opening - Warehouse Associate

Sun Print Management – Holiday, FL 34690

For over 25 years Sun Print has provided exceptional managed print services to large and small businesses across the nation. We supply printers, parts, and supplies for customers nationwide while still maintaining a unique small business culture. We strive to understand and reflect our customers' values so we can always provide the best service in all circumstances. Our unparalleled managed print services (MPS) program is trusted by clients across many industries such as healthcare, retail, insurance, financial services, hospitality, government, and education.

This position is responsible for sorting and organizer of incoming and outgoing items in coordination with other warehouse staff to complete all daily duties. Must be able to handle periodic deliveries to customer sites with personal vehicle and/or public transportation.

Duties and skills include but are not limited to:

Maintain an accurate inventory where needed.

Interpersonal skills and professional verbal communication skills.

Ability to lift 50+ pounds as needed.

Perform other duties as directed, such as basic facilities and building maintenance.

Organizational skills * required.*

Basic knowledge in MS Windows, Outlook, Excel and Teams.

Job Type: Temporary 3 to 6 months

Pay: From $28.00 per hour


8 hour shift. Monday to Friday

Company Description

Founded in 1995 in the Tampa Bay area, Sun Print Management began with a small but dedicated team of five, specializing in IBM/AS400 mainframe services. Their unwavering commitment to excellence quickly opened new doors, leading to a pivotal breakthrough—clients sought a simpler, more efficient way to manage laser printers. This demand sparked the creation of Sun Print’s revolutionary "penny-a-print" program, an initiative that laid the foundation for what is now recognized as Print as a Service (PaaS). Through this model, Sun Print transformed the way businesses approach print device management, offering streamlined solutions that maximize efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

Steady Growth & Industry Leadership
Through steady, organic growth, Sun Print Management has expanded its reach nationwide, now overseeing print devices in all 50 states, including Alaska and Hawaii. More than two decades later, the company has built an impressive legacy, managing 250,000 devices across 3,500+ client locations nationwide.

Sun Print’s Managed Print Services (MPS) program has emerged as an industry leader, serving a diverse range of sectors—including Healthcare, Retail, Insurance, Financial Services, Hospitality, Government, and Education. Their commitment to innovation, efficiency, and client success continues to redefine modern print management, empowering businesses with cutting-edge solutions tailored to their evolving needs.

At Sun Print Management, the future of printing isn’t just about technology—it’s about delivering smarter, more seamless solutions that drive real business impact.

jobs.title: Security Guard for Events
jobs.description:
A2A Security is looking for a reliable and professional Security Officer for Events in Austin, TX. Your primary role will be to ensure the safety and security of various events, control access for guests, and maintain a secure atmosphere. This position plays a crucial role in preventing incidents and adhering to safety standards. Key Responsibilities: - Control access for guests and personnel attending events. - Vigilantly monitor event areas for unauthorized individuals, suspicious behavior, and safety risks. - React promptly and effectively to incidents and emergencies. - Provide help and information to guests when necessary. - Write incident reports and keep precise records of activities. - Enforce event rules and regulations to guarantee a secure environment. Requirements: - A valid Texas Security Guard License is mandatory. - Prior experience in event security is preferred. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are necessary. - Reliability, punctuality, and professionalism are critical attributes. - Ability to remain calm and effective in stressful situations. Working Conditions: - This is a part-time position. - Shifts may include evenings and weekends depending on event schedules. - Competitive pay starting at $18.00 per hour, commensurate with experience. How to Apply: Interested applicants should submit their resumes along with their contact details. Selected candidates will be contacted directly for an interview. Join our team as a Security Officer for Events and be a key player in ensuring the safety of our events and gatherings. In this active role, you will implement essential security measures to protect attendees, staff, and property. Your proactive efforts will foster a secure environment where guests can fully enjoy their experience. Responsibilities include: - Monitoring event locations through surveillance tools like CCTV to spot suspicious activities or security breaches. - Conducting thorough access control checks, including background verification of attendees, staff, and vendors. - Responding swiftly to emergencies by following established emergency protocols, including first aid, CPR, AED use, and fire safety. - Managing crowd control and conflict resolution to create a safe and pleasant environment for all. - Documenting security incidents and unusual activities in detailed reports. - Patrolling event areas to identify potential hazards or security weaknesses, ensuring compliance with security requirements. - Assisting with lifting or manual tasks needed for event setup or breakdown. Skills: - Strong monitoring skills using CCTV systems and other surveillance tools. - Background in military or law enforcement is beneficial for managing high-pressure situations effectively. - Certification in first aid, CPR, AED operation, and fire safety for confident emergency response. - Proficient in writing incident reports with a focus on accuracy and detail. - Experience with access control systems and performing background checks for authorized entry. - Skilled in conflict management and customer service to ensure positive interactions while maintaining safety. - Knowledgeable in physical security practices, including Taser use and firearm handling (where permitted). - Capacity to perform routine patrols, CCTV monitoring, loss prevention, and compliance with security regulations in diverse settings. Become an integral part of our team as a Security Officer for Events and help us create secure and enjoyable experiences for everyone involved!Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and vigilant Security Guard for Events to ensure the safety and security of attendees, staff, and property during various events. This role involves proactive surveillance, access control, emergency response, and conflict management to create a safe environment where everyone can enjoy the event experience. The ideal candidate will be energetic, detail-oriented, and committed to maintaining high standards of security compliance while providing excellent customer service. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to be an integral part of vibrant event environments, ensuring safety with professionalism and confidence.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor event venues through CCTV surveillance systems and perform regular patrols to identify potential security risks or suspicious activity.
  • Control access points using advanced access control systems, verifying credentials, performing background checks when necessary, and managing attendee flow efficiently.
  • Respond swiftly to incidents or emergencies by executing established emergency response procedures, including fire safety protocols and first aid administration.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual occurrences during events.
  • Manage conflict de-escalation techniques to resolve disputes peacefully while maintaining a calm and authoritative presence.
  • Conduct thorough background checks on staff or vendors as required to ensure compliance with security regulations.
  • Operate specialized security equipment such as Taser devices, AEDs (Automated External Defibrillators), firearms (where permitted), and perform manual handling tasks including heavy lifting when necessary for crowd control or equipment setup.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement agencies during investigations or incidents, providing accurate information and support as needed.
  • Perform routine patrolling of the venue’s perimeter and interior spaces to uphold physical security standards and prevent unauthorized access.
  • Assist in emergency evacuation procedures ensuring all attendees are guided safely out of the venue in case of fire, medical emergency, or other hazards.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in security roles, preferably within event environments or related fields such as military or law enforcement backgrounds.
  • Strong knowledge of surveillance techniques including CCTV operation and monitoring.
  • Certification in first aid, CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation), AED operation, and fire safety is highly desirable.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks including heavy lifting safely and effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills for incident report writing, customer service interactions, and conflict management.
  • Familiarity with access control systems and security technology such as CCTV cameras and alarm systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain calm under pressure while executing emergency response procedures confidently.
  • Physical fitness to stand for extended periods, patrol large venues, and perform physically demanding tasks when required.
  • Knowledge of legal regulations related to security operations and compliance standards applicable in public event settings.

Join us in delivering secure, enjoyable experiences at every event! Your vigilance makes a difference in creating safe environments where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Supervisory Federal Air Marshal (ASAC)
jobs.description:
Summary

The Law Enforcement/Federal Air Marshal Service (LE/FAMS) deploys Federal Air Marshals on U.S. aircraft worldwide and conducts protection, response, detection, and assessment activities in airports and transportation systems.

Learn more about this agency

Duties

Help

This is a secondary law enforcement position. Under the authority of the Aviation and Transportation Security Act (ATSA) (PL 107-71, November 19, 2001), the incumbent functions as a Federal Law Enforcement Officer and performs the duties and responsibilities assigned to Federal Air Marshals.

The Law Enforcement/Federal Air Marshal Service (LE/FAMS) promotes public confidence in the security of our Nation's transportation domain by detecting, deterring and defeating criminal and terrorist acts. To achieve this mission, LE/FAMS deploys Federal Air Marshals on U.S. aircraft world-wide; conducts protection, response, detection, and assessment activities in airports and other transportation systems. This position serves as an Assistant Supervisory Air Marshal in Charge (ASAC).High-level duties include:

  • Directs the work of subordinate Supervisory Federal Air Marshals (SFAMS) and Federal Air Marshals (FAMs) and performs supervisory duties including: assigning tasks, setting priorities, monitoring and evaluating performance, coaching, and developing employee capabilities, approving leave, and taking and recommending appropriate corrective/disciplinary action; defines plans and organizes assigned resources (staff, budget, equipment, etc.) to accomplish objectives; manages budget and either reallocates resources among components or projects or requests additional resources, as needed; projects short-term and long-term future needs and justifies resource requirements. Functions as a Federal Law Enforcement Officer and performs the duties and responsibilities assigned to the FAMS.
  • Establishes and maintains liaison with other federal, state and local law enforcement at all levels, including those from private industry. Must be able to articulate both verbally and in writing the LE/FAMS field office goals and objectives to local, state and federal law enforcement partners, as well as a myriad of transportation security stakeholders. The incumbent has authority to make commitments for the major organizational component within guidelines.
  • Serves as an advisor to the field office SAC as well as consultant to other senior leadership when needed. Assists in the planning and directing of field office FAMS activities including planning, scheduling, implementing short- and long-term strategic planning, resource management, and all aspects of FAMS law enforcement and investigations when applicable to assigned area of responsibility. Work is typically governed by established policies, procedures, and organizational objectives that frequently leave room for discretion. Resolves all but unique problems without intervention of higher-level management. Regularly called upon to identify problem areas and to develop and recommend new policies and procedures for resolution. Individual and organizational performance is typically reviewed periodically through status reports and performance measures; has discretion to ensure alignment of operations, projects, and/or programs with tactical (short-term) objectives of the major subdivision.


Supervisory/Managerial duties includes serving as a first line supervisor for the organization. This includes but is not limited to: assigning work, setting priorities, and reviewing and evaluating work and performance of subordinates; approving leave; coaching and developing employees; recommending corrective or disciplinary actions; assisting in budget planning and projecting short-term needs; managing projects within assigned resources; resolving routine problems that typically impact the objectives of the organizational unit; and when required, coordinating with customers outside the immediate organization.

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

  1. You must possess U.S. Citizenship or be a U.S. National.
  2. You must complete a favorable Background Investigation (BI).
  3. You must have reached the minimum age (21) at the time of application.
  4. Selective Service registration is required.


Additional Conditions of Employment in Qualifications Section.

If you fail to meet the conditions of employment or any other pre-employment requirements, such as missing any of the scheduled appointments, the hiring agency may rescind their tentative offer of employment.

Applying to this announcement certifies that you give permission for TSA to share your application with others in DHS for similar positions.

Any offers of employment made pursuant to this announcement will be consistent with all applicable authorities, including Presidential Memoranda, Executive Orders, interpretive U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) guidance, and Office of Management and Budget plans and policies concerning hiring. These authorities are subject to change.

Employees who transfer to TSA from an agency that allows employees to maintain an annual leave balance higher than the maximum accumulation for the appointed position will have their leave ceiling set to the maximum accumulation for the appointed position (e.g., United States duty location - 240 hours, foreign duty location - 360 hours, or TSES position - 720 hours). TSA will not make a monetary payment for any leave forfeited under these circumstances.

Qualifications

To qualify for the SV-K Pay Band (equivalent to GS-15), you must have one year of specialized experience at the -J or GS-14 in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private sector. Specialized experience is defined as experience that has equipped you with the knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. Specialized experience is defined as:

  • Applying knowledge of Law Enforcement/Federal Air Marshal Service (LE/FAMS) mission, and related managerial and operational training principles.
  • Applying law enforcement functions, laws, policies, and procedures to include familiarization with judicial process, criminal statues, rules of evidence, precedent court decisions, and legal aspects of investigations.


Conditions of Employment

  1. Top Secret (TS) Security clearance required. This is a critical-sensitive position, and the selectee must successfully obtain and maintain a TS clearance as a condition of placement/retention in the position.
  2. Be willing to undertake extensive travel, at times overnight, as required.
  3. Successful drug and alcohol tests (negative result) and subsequent random drug/alcohol testing in accordance with TSA policy.
  4. This is a confidential financial disclosure (OGE Form 450) filing position.
  5. This position is emergency essential. DHS TSA employees may be subject to 24-hour on call duty in the event of an emergency. This service may require irregular working hours, work at locations other than the official duty station, and may include duties other than those specified in the position description. Selectees must be able to relocate to emergency sites with little advance notice and function under intense physical and mental stress.
  6. Must carry a firearm and maintain proficiency.
  7. Must meet qualifying medical and physical fitness standards.
  8. Incumbent is expected to successfully complete all agency-required training.

Job Description

As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively.

Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!

Hours

  • 8:00 am – 4:30 pm

Compensation

At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $49,040 - $61,300. Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.

Join Our Team as a Security Officer!

S&C Electric Company is seeking a dynamic individual to coordinate our security function. As a Security Officer, you’ll be crucial in ensuring smooth operations and supporting our diverse team. Officers perform duties in three main categories, including patrolling the S&C Ridge Boulevard Industrial Campus facility, working in the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), and operating the security gatehouses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Utilize strong, written communication skills by creating clear and accurate incident and field activity reports in a timely manner.
  • Conduct and document events/ investigations with close attention to detail; gather and summarize statements and facts for records.
  • Perform routine and scheduled patrols of the S&C Campus to: regulate traffic and parking, ensure team member safety, respond to emergencies/incidents.
  • Act as first responders to critical and emergent situations including: medical emergencies, fires, hazardous material releases/spills, unauthorized personnel on campus, confined space rescues, severe weather, and building evacuations.
  • Certify and maintain required certification in the use of self-contained breathing apparatus and/or respirators.
  • Monitor fire, building supervisory, high-voltage supply, intrusion alarm, and closed-circuit video systems while assigned to the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC).
  • Monitor entry/exit and access to S&C Campus, with attention to detail for guiding team members, vehicles, visitors, and contractors. Maintain accurate logs and records of all commercial-related entrants.
  • Issue temporary identification badges and parking permits to authorized individuals.
  • Coordinate logistics of commercial deliveries and shipments from the GSOC.
  • Operate communication systems by serving as radio dispatchers and telephone switchboard operators during off-hours.
  • Directly identifying and addressing safety, trespassing and workplace violence concerns, which may include, but is not limited to, the detaining of threatening individuals for police resolution.
  • Safely remove unauthorized individuals from the campus using various de-escalation techniques.
  • Maintaining licensing and certifications for essential training and equipment necessary to perform job duties. (PERC, FOID, DL)
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
  • Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
  • Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
  • Drive a car or other vehicle.
  • Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • High School diploma or acceptable General Educational Development (GED), some college preferred.
  • Illinois Driver’s License and Illinois Firearms Owner’s Identification Card.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills; proficiency with personal computers.
  • State of Illinois Security Officer 40-Hour Training Program for armed security
  • A Permanent Employee Registration Card (PERC) and ability to successfully obtain the Firearm Authorization Card (FAC) issued from the State of Illinois, Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.
  • 4 years of security or related background. Industrial security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong computer and technological skills
  • Conflict resolution skills
  • De-escalation and high stress management skills
  • Understanding laws and regulations pertaining to armed security work
  • Understanding signals of distress or impairment in others

Preferred

  • Associates Degree in Security, Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, or related field.
  • Any advanced National Incident Management System (NIMS) training.
  • Handcuffing certification.
  • De-escalation training i.e., Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI) or Crisis Intervention (CIT) Training certifications

Major Physical Demands

  • Frequently required to stand and perform tasks for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position and perform desk-based for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.

  • Occasionally required to position self to perform tasks involving but not limited to reaching, twisting, rotating, and pushing/pulling.
  • Occasionally required to use hand-eye coordination to control both hands and arms for a full range of motion to operate equipment/machinery/power tools/office productivity equipment.
  • Frequently ascending or descending ladders/stairs/scaffolding/ramps/poles.
  • Frequently required to observe details at close range, including depth perception, peripheral vision, and the ability to differentiate between colors.
  • Continuously required to talk and hear in person and by phone/conference calls.
  • Frequently required to travel (up to 10%) and work extended hours when necessary.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Provides security services with a customer-service approach, focusing on professionalism, fairness, and compassion even in challenging circumstances and in accordance with policies, procedures, and training.

  • Inspires confidence in patients, visitors, and team members by presenting a professional, approachable, and service-oriented appearance and demeanor. Is alert, observant, and ethical. Complies with and enforces all safety and security rules and regulations. Maintains Department uniform and equipment in good repair.

  • Performs routine responsibilities during interior and exterior patrols to ensure safety and security, including but not limited to inspections to identify vulnerabilities, hazards, and fire conditions, audits of Interim Life Safety Measures, patient valuables management, and thorough contraband searches.   • Liaisons with federal, state, and local law enforcement and first responder agencies. Coordinates, briefs, and monitors every law enforcement prisoner patient guard to ensure policy compliance and prevent unsafe practices.

  • Assists with exterior traffic and crowd control, including parking enforcement, valet parking assist, and vehicular assistance.

  • Utilizes Interview and Interrogation tactics to uncover information about incidents that have occurred.

  • Completes patrolling with a community-oriented approach.

First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.

  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)

  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods

jobs.title: Security & Law Enforcement
jobs.description:
Job Title : Security & Law Enforcement (Master-at-Arms) Category / Component : Enlisted • Active This role is open to both entry-level applicants and candidates with prior experience. Those with a background in Law Enforcement, Corrections/Parole, or as a Security Practitioner may qualify for direct-entry consideration at an advanced paygrade (E-4 to E-6) depending on experience. Overview Master-at-Arms (MA) Sailors provide the Navy’s core security, antiterrorism, and law enforcement capability, protecting people, installations, ships, and strategic assets at home and abroad. They conduct force protection, physical security, and policing on bases, aboard ships, at sea, and in expeditionary environments, and may specialize in areas such as military working dogs, harbor security, corrections, investigations, or protective services. Key Responsibilities Conduct antiterrorism and force protection patrols on installations and piers; stand sentry and access control posts and control entry to secure areas; perform vehicle, personnel, and baggage inspections to detect weapons, contraband, or unauthorized items; enforce traffic and parking regulations, respond to calls for service, and investigate incidents and traffic accidents; collect and preserve evidence and prepare reports and case files; provide law enforcement presence and crowd control during special events and emergencies; operate and maintain small arms, crew-served weapons, non-lethal weapons, and security vehicles or boats; support harbor and waterside security, high-value unit escorts, and expeditionary security missions; supervise and train junior security force personnel in watchstanding, weapons, and security procedures. What to Expect Work in a fast-paced, armed, and safety-critical environment where attention to detail, judgment, and professionalism are essential; frequent duty in rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to provide 24/7 security and law enforcement coverage; exposure to stressful situations involving emergencies, accidents, or criminal activity, requiring calm decision-making and strong communication; ongoing qualification and requalification in weapons, use of force, tactical skills, and physical fitness; increasing responsibility over time as you qualify for specialized billets such as patrol supervisor, watch commander, kennel master, or investigator. Work Environment Assignments at Navy installations in the U.S. and overseas, aboard aircraft carriers and other ships, and with expeditionary security units and strategic weapons facilities; work primarily on bases, piers, flight lines, harbor security boats, and in patrol vehicles, kennels, armories, and security operations centers; opportunities for overseas, forward-deployed, and dependent-restricted tours that count as sea duty for rotation; close integration with other security forces, Marine units, NCIS, and joint or host-nation partners depending on billet. Pathways, Training & Advancement Recruit Training followed by Master-at-Arms Class “A” School at Lackland AFB, where you learn basic law enforcement, weapons handling, antiterrorism, patrol procedures, and security operations; progressive on-the-job qualification through Personnel Qualification Standards, watchstations, and unit training; opportunities for advanced schools that award Navy Enlisted Classifications such as Military Working Dog Handler and Kennel Master, Harbor Security Coxswain and Patrol Leader, Corrections Specialist, Small Arms Instructor, Crew-Served Weapons Instructor, Protective Service Specialist, and Criminal Investigator; career-long development through leadership courses, warfare qualifications (such as ESWS, EAWS, EXW, FMF, or NWS when assigned to qualifying commands), and senior enlisted leader programs. Enlist directly into the Master-at-Arms rating and attend MA “A” School after Recruit Training, then report to an operational security force billet at an installation, ship, or expeditionary unit; Reserve opportunities may exist in Navy Security Force and Maritime Expeditionary Security units for qualified prior-service or SELRES applicants, often requiring completion of MA “A” School or equivalent training and, for some billets, specific NECs or follow-on schools; prior-service Sailors from other ratings may be able to convert into MA based on community needs and screening. Qualifications All Navy jobs require meeting general enlistment or commissioning standards, which typically include: Eligibility to serve in the United States Navy, which may involve United States citizenship or other legal residency and work status, depending on the program and current law and policy A high school diploma or equivalent for enlisted positions, and a bachelor’s or qualifying professional degree for officer positions Meeting age limits that vary by program and are set in law and Navy policy. Some communities have more restrictive age ranges Meeting medical, vision, and dental standards, including body composition and physical fitness requirements, with some jobs requiring more demanding standards Meeting character and conduct standards, including background screening Achieving required test scores for your program, such as the Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery for enlisted roles or officer qualification tests for officer programs Eligibility for a security clearance when required for your rating or designator Additional qualifications can include specific skills, education, licensure, or experience that are unique to a job or community and will be reviewed with you by a recruiter. Additional qualifications for this job may include: United States citizenship or other status as allowed by current policy, with most billets requiring eligibility for a security clearance; strong moral character and clean legal history suitable for armed law enforcement duties; ability to meet Navy medical and physical fitness standards and to qualify with small arms and other weapons; comfort working in uniformed law enforcement and security roles, often carrying firearms and equipment for extended periods; willingness to work rotating shifts, deploy, and accept assignment to sea duty, overseas locations, and dependent-restricted tours when required. Education Education benefits are available through standard Navy programs such as Tuition Assistance, the Post-9/11 GI Bill, ACE-recommended college credit for Navy training, Navy COOL-funded certifications, USMAP apprenticeships, and other Navy College Program opportunities. Specific options depend on the Sailor’s status, training, and current Navy policy. Pay, Benefits & Service Pay, benefits, and service commitments follow standard Navy Active and/or Reserve policies for this type of role, including basic pay, allowances when eligible, health coverage, and retirement options. Exact entitlements, special pays, and service obligations depend on program, component, years of service, and current law and Navy guidance. Incentives Incentives such as bonuses, special pays, and loan repayment may be available at times for specific ratings or communities, but they change frequently and cannot be guaranteed. Applicants must confirm current incentives and eligibility with an official Navy recruiter or authoritative Navy source. Notes and Disclaimers This description is a general overview of typical duties, training, and opportunities in this community. It does not replace official Navy instructions, policies, or contracts and does not guarantee specific assignments, training, incentives, or outcomes. Join Allied Universal as a Security Officer supporting an aerospace and defense location. You will monitor assigned areas, conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide professional customer service and communication. Grow with us...

Life at Starwood Hotels is based on a simple idea: the world is beautiful and we want to keep it that way. But we can’t do it alone. That’s why hiring thoughtful and inspiring Team Members and Leaders who understand that our people, collaboration, stellar service, and respect for nature are so important to us.

Main Duties

The Loss Prevention Officer is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment throughout the property by proactively identifying risks, enforcing safety and security policies, responding to incidents, and providing support to guests and team members. This role balances vigilance with hospitality, ensuring safety is upheld without compromising the guest experience.

General Duties

  • Patrol hotel property, both interior and exterior, to observe people, conditions, and activities, ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable laws.
  • Maintain fixed posts or conduct mobile patrols as assigned to monitor activity and prevent theft, vandalism, or unsafe behavior.
  • Enforce safety and security procedures to ensure a safe environment for guests, residents, visitors, and team members.
  • Monitor and control access to restricted areas, including back-of-house spaces.
  • Respond promptly to calls for service, assess situations, take appropriate action, and communicate status updates to management.
  • Perform crowd control and scene management during incidents, events, or emergencies.
  • Gather accurate and complete information related to incidents, accidents, or security concerns and prepare detailed reports.
  • Execute Lost & Found procedures in accordance with company standards.
  • Monitor employee and vendor access, report unauthorized access, and log vendors and visitors as required.
  • Escort guests, team members, and valuables as needed using the most efficient and discreet routes.
  • Respond to incidents involving disturbances, threats, or acts of violence in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.
  • Detain individuals when necessary and permitted, following established protocols.
  • Provide medical assistance, including First Aid, CPR, and AED use, within the scope of training until emergency responders arrive.
  • Maintain knowledge of the location and condition of emergency equipment and medical kits; report deficiencies promptly.
  • Assist with emergency evacuations and life safety procedures as required.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally via radio, phone, and in person, using proper radio etiquette and codes.
  • Maintain a professional, calm, and courteous demeanor at all times, regardless of external pressures.
  • Promote a positive guest experience while enforcing safety and security standards.
  • Look for opportunities to assist guests, colleagues, and other departments whenever possible.
  • Attend required training sessions and apply learned knowledge to daily operations.
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; properly store flammable materials.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, and standards with self and colleagues.
  • Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional.
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information.
  • Embody the 1 Hotels Vision, Mission and Compass; deliver on Our Promise, provide Good-Natured Service and uphold our Brand Pillars.

  • Prior experience in security, loss prevention, military, or law enforcement preferred.
  • Luxury hotel or resort experience strongly preferred.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • CPR, First Aid, and AED certification required (or ability to obtain).
  • Alcohol Awareness certification required (or ability to obtain).
  • Any required state or local security licenses must be obtained and maintained.
  • Must successfully complete company-required security training and annual assessments.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; additional languages a plus.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to de-escalate situations calmly and professionally.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong observation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • High level of integrity, discretion, and confidentiality.
  • Proficiency with basic computer systems, security software, reporting tools, and mobile devices.

  • Ability to sit, kneel, bend, crouch, and climb stairs as required.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to respond quickly to emergencies and physically demanding situations.
  • Ability to work in varying environmental conditions.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

Job Title

Patrols designated areas and/or secures assigned station for the purpose of observing, investigating and/or otherwise responding to inquiries, disturbances, emergencies and other routine or unusual incidents involving the college community, visitors, and the public; secures premises and controls pedestrian and traffic access; enforces specific rules and laws as mandated; frequently uses independent judgment in the execution of duty.

  • High School diploma or its equivalent.
  • Twenty-one years of age.
  • Possess a current state Driver's License.
  • Successfully pass a criminal background check; Have no criminal record of convictions of felonies or misdemeanors.
  • Must successfully pass a pre-employment Drug and Alcohol Test.
  • Must have current part-time police officer certification.

Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

Warehouse Associates are accountable for accurately performing a combination of manual and automated tasks necessary for receipt, storage, transporting, picking, packing, shipping, staging, delivery etc. of product that may be hazardous, temperature sensitive, or of high value amid continuously demonstrating behaviors aligned with Abbvie’s attributes and values.

Responsibilities

  • Comply with all appropriate policies and procedures to successfully maintain training, safety, GxP, and governmental agency standards.
  • Ability to comprehend and accurately process paperwork in accordance with policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
  • Responsible for cross-training in multiple areas of the operation while maintaining a low level of quality mistakes.
  • Accurately receive and inspect inbound product/material for infestation, overages, shortages, and damages (OS&D).
  • Efficiently and correctly pick customer orders for shipment, ensuring that the correct number and type of product is picked.
  • Transfers and locates material/product to general storage areas or shipping locations.
  • Verify quantity, quality, labeling and address with the customer’s order to ensure outgoing shipments are complete and accurate.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED to ensure ability to accurately complete basic math calculations, read and understand training documents, product labeling and warehouse signage written in English.
  • Pass medical screening and background checks that may be conducted by local, state, and/or federal authorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
  • Self-motivated with ability to work in a fast-paced positive team-oriented environment, coupled with good multi-tasking skills.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft office products, general computer skills and RF scanners. Ability to comprehend and execute standard problem-solving skills and effectively communicate verbally and written.
  • Capable of lifting 50 lbs., and/or more with assistance. Able to bend, reach, stoop, climb, stand and walk for entire shift of 8 hours or more.
  • Operate various types of material handling equipment including but not limited to forklifts, hand tools and other devices operated in a warehouse environment while maintaining the highest level of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to complete assigned tasks.
  • Ability to work in an atmosphere range of 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F).

This range may be modified in the future. ​

  • This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law. ​
