jobs.title: Event Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role
 Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor. Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader
Key Responsibilities
 Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.
  • Supervise event-day execution, ensuring client security needs and account standards are fully met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and coordinate accurate post-event payroll, time processing, and billing data.
  • Act as the primary lead or step in for the Account Manager in their absence.
Staffing, Onboarding & Development
  • Assist with the onboarding, training, scheduling, and distribution of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Deliver pre-event briefings and address large groups (ranging from small teams to 600+ personnel).
  • Evaluate monthly event metrics, staff performance, and employee performance indicators (call-offs, attendance, counseling notes).
  • Coach, mentor, and guide supervisors and staff through personnel issues in accordance with company policy.
Logistics & Equipment Management
  • Manage the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue radios, scanners, and ISS devices.
  • Prepare operational materials, shift rosters, and briefing documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit formal equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of operational needs.
Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations
  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.title: Security Shift Supervisor
jobs.description:
Titan Security is built on serving our clients and building careers – just like yours. We are trusted by some of the most well-known companies and properties in the country while remaining dedicated to building personalized security solutions that solve the needs of every customer we support. Named as a nationally recognized Top Workplace in 2024 and 2025 by USA Today, Titan's customized approach to security services will provide you with the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed. Our core values of being Unified, Transparent, Innovative, Committed and Accountable help us in providing unparalleled service and support in all that we do. If you are looking for a meaningful career, a culture of excellence, and the ability to make a difference, we want to talk to you!

We are seeking an operational, customer-service-driven Security Shift Supervisor to manage on-duty security operations for a premier 24-story, 1.3 million-square-foot multi-purpose complex in Chicago’s River North area. Reporting directly to the Security Director, this role leads on-duty security officers, oversees access control and CCTV systems, and acts as a vital bridge between ownership, management, and the security team.

Currently have 2 Shifts open: 1) Wed-Sun 11pm-7am 2) Sun 7-3pm and Mon-Thurs 3-11pm

Responsibilities:

  • Lead, direct, and motivate security officers during assigned shifts to enforce company policies, post orders, and safety guidelines.
  • Report directly to Site Supervisor/Director and/or Marksman / Titan Management.
  • Ensure the Client Site is provided with high quality security services to protect people and property.
  • Handle all escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately.
  • Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, recognition, etc.).
  • Provide the basis of a great work environment by treating staff with respect.
  • Assist in the Coordination and/or conduct site-specific “on the job training”, client–specific training and annual refresher training for staff by adhering to Titan’s training standards.
  • Reconcile logs, shift responsibilities and patrols; review incident reports prior to submitting to Site Supervisor and/or Director and coordinate preliminary investigations.
  • Develop/maintain operational procedures and post orders that are always available for emergency reference by staff.
  • Train and qualify to work assigned post. Understands the specific and general post instructions for that assigned post. Maintain practical knowledge of all additional and emergency post instructions that are called for by the client.
  • Maintain access control procedures set by building management.
  • Effectively utilize access control systems, visitor management systems and CCTV systems as needed.
  • Identify all tenants and/or visitors upon arrival.
  • Ensure visitors and vendors are properly signed in prior to accessing the building.
  • Observe departing personnel to guard against theft of tenant or building property.
  • Monitor security cameras that are within the facility.
  • Respond to incidents including property emergencies.
  • Conduct general patrols of the entire property during various hours, if required, including numerous flights of stairs and frequent patrols of the exterior in any weather conditions.
  • Ability to stand/sit/walk for extended periods of time.
  • Assist tenants and visitors with directions and general business information.
  • Clearly and accurately record data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, and malfunctioning of equipment, to building and Titan management.
  • Maintain clear, accurate logs pertaining to people or property including packages.
  • Provide excellent Customer Service to all parties encountered while on duty.
  • Other duties as assigned.

***These positions require at least 2 years of continuous supervisory experience.***

Qualifications

Education and/or Experience: High School diploma or general education degree (GED) and 3 years prior satisfactory employment as a security officer or directly related experience. Must be at least 18 years of age.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Valid Security License if required by state, driver’s license as applicable.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Bi-lingual considered a plus.

Other Qualifications: Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check. Must maintain a working telephone number though which we can contact you.

Physical Demands: The physical demands are based on the contract and must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. A list of these job duties is inclusive of, but not limited to: candidates must be able to stand for extended periods of time; be able to lift, push, and/or pull at least 50 lbs.; be able to accommodate foot patrols on the interior & exterior of the assigned facility; be able to perform assigned duties regardless of inclement weather.

Pay and Benefits of Security Supervisors:

  • $22.50- $23.00 / hour
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Medical and Dental insurance
  • Opportunities for career growth and promotion
  • Skills-enhancing training

About the Role
 Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor. Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

 Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.

jobs.description:
Organization- Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

Summary

Schedule Requirements: Must be available to work a flexible schedule during the week, including weekends and holidays.

Role

The Security Officer is responsible for the oversight of the safety and security of the hotel guests and employees. This person will follow safety and security standards and complete incident reports as required.

Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Ensure the overall safety and security of the hotel guests, Colleagues and hotel premises
  • Act as a member of the Emergency Response Team, responding in cases of fire, accident, safety concerns and calls for medical assistance
  • Investigate and report any violations to law or hotel policy
  • Provide First Aid and C.P.R. as required
  • Conduct regular floor patrols, cash counts and crowd control
  • Maintain computer records of all actions in a Daily Activity Report
  • Assist guests regarding hotel facilities in an informative and helpful way

About Our Resort

Nestled across 300 scenic acres in the heart of Texas Hill Country, Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Villas is San Antonio's premier luxury resort destination, where authentic Texas hospitality meets world-class amenities and unforgettable experiences.

Fresh off a multi-million-dollar transformation, our award-winning resort features beautifully redesigned guest rooms, an expanded collection of luxury villas, enhanced dining experiences, revitalized meeting and event spaces, and exciting new recreation offerings designed to elevate every guest stay.

Guests can unwind at our full-service Windflower Spa, enjoy 27 holes of championship golf, float along our signature lazy river, and experience the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure that has made us a leading destination for leisure travelers, corporate groups, weddings, and special events. Our unique event venues include the stunning Rancher Hall Event Barn, offering an authentic Texas backdrop for memorable celebrations and gatherings.

Recognized as the #1 Resort in San Antonio by TripAdvisor and consistently ranked among the top resorts in Texas, Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Villas continues to set the standard for exceptional guest experiences.

As we enter an exciting new era of growth, innovation, and elevated luxury, we are seeking passionate hospitality professionals who are inspired to lead, create meaningful connections, and help shape the future of one of Texas' most celebrated resort destinations. Here, you'll find more than a career—you'll find opportunities to grow, develop, and make a lasting impact while working alongside a team that truly cares for one another and our guests.

Why Join Us?

At Hyatt, we prioritize creating a culture where colleagues feel like family. Since 1957, we've grown into one of the world's leading hospitality brands by valuing our people. We transform jobs into fulfilling careers, turning guest stays into unforgettable journeys, and fostering an environment where belonging and care thrive.

Qualifications

  • A true desire to satisfy the needs of others in a fast paced environment
  • Refined verbal and written communication skills to provide guests and colleagues elevated service
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time and walk moderate distances
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays
  • Proficient in basic computer skills
  • Previous security experience preferred

Benefits & Perks

  • Health, dental and vision benefits
  • Discounted & complimentary hotel room nights
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Employee stock option plan
  • Enjoy complimentary meals in our colleague café
  • Tuition reimbursement, up to $1,000 a year
  • Excellent training and professional development
  • Opportunities to work around the world with Hyatt Hotels and Resorts

About The Hiring Process

We are excited that you have chosen to express interest in joining Hyatt Hotels and Resorts. We will be sure to take a look at your application and get back to you within a week of your submission. Thank you for your patience while we do so.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required, as well as a completed background check.

jobs.description:
We have great opportunity for those seeking a new challenge, but also a fantastic place to work. Come grow with us!

SPS offers a competitive benefits package including paid time off, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, legal and life insurance, transit program, referral bonuses, pet discounts, EAP, and a 401K with company match.

Schedule: Typically Monday - Friday, 7:30AM-4:30PM/8AM-5PM (Flexes based on area assisting with)

What You Will Be Doing

  • Giving amazing customer service to our onsite operation by scanning/delivering/tracking/reporting in and outgoing business packages and mail (via UPS, USPS, Fedex, etc).
  • Assisting the onsite personnel in retrieving their packages and providing records management in person, by email, by phone, or similar methods.
  • Oversee the onsite business center, which may include: office supply stocking, assisting with copy/print orders, conference room setup up, pantry inventory, or light facilities.
  • Serves as backup to route driving roles, which provide delivery to onsite personnel for packages, pallets, etc.

What We Need From You

  • 3+ year experience in shipping & receiving, mailroom, route driving, or similar services.
  • Valid U.S. Driver's License, must be at least 25 years old to meet our standards to company car insurance, and have had license for at least 5 years.
  • A positive and professional attitude with a willingness to go above and beyond for our customers.
  • Previous material handling skills a plus, including ability to use motorized and manual equipment such as forklifts (in locations where they are needed), pallet jacks, and hand trucks.
  • Ability to perform the following types of physical activities: lift up to 50 pounds, push/pull to move equipment, bend/stoop/squat/kneel, and reach above shoulders
  • Background and experience working in a warehouse or loading dock environment, with exposure to varied weather conditions a plus.
  • Must be willing to be cross-trained to support all tasks required for that site, including, but not limited to: routes, receiving, mail services, shipping, floaters, freight coordination & logistics, loading dock operations, and customer service/help desk. Must be experienced with and able to troubleshoot issues regarding tracking software, secure lockers, and other tools & technology used by the SRM team. Must remain flexible and ready to support the needs of the business. In some field offices, Supervisors will collaborate with cross functional partners to support waste, secure waste, and eWaste programs.

Compensation

The expected compensation is an estimate, and the final offer will depend on skills, experience, location, and other job-related factors.

Vacancy Status

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Pay Range

$21 - $21 USD

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: An opportunity to enter a job that allows you to learn new skills or use a variety of them that may lead you to uncover other career opportunities.
  • Learning & Development: At SPS, we promote a work culture of learning so that you can develop to be the best at what you do.
  • We Recognize Talent: We offer a variety of recognition programs for all levels of employees.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.title: Event Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role
Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor.
Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader
Key Responsibilities
Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.
  • Supervise event-day execution, ensuring client security needs and account standards are fully met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and coordinate accurate post-event payroll, time processing, and billing data.
  • Act as the primary lead or step in for the Account Manager in their absence.
Staffing, Onboarding & Development
  • Assist with the onboarding, training, scheduling, and distribution of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Deliver pre-event briefings and address large groups (ranging from small teams to 600+ personnel).
  • Evaluate monthly event metrics, staff performance, and employee performance indicators (call-offs, attendance, counseling notes).
  • Coach, mentor, and guide supervisors and staff through personnel issues in accordance with company policy.
Logistics & Equipment Management
  • Manage the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue radios, scanners, and ISS devices.
  • Prepare operational materials, shift rosters, and briefing documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit formal equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of operational needs.
Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations
  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

Primary Purpose:

Under direct supervision, provide security and protection for students, campus personnel, patrons, and district property.

Two-way radio, CCTV, personal computer, and alarm systems

Maintain emotional control and professionalism under stress; prolonged standing; strenuous walking and climbing of stairs, able to see and hear with or without reasonable accommodation, moderate lifting and carrying (up to 40 pounds). Able to physically respond to emergencies, control sudden violent or extreme physical acts of others and exhibit rapid mental and muscular coordination simultaneously. May be subject to adverse and hazardous working conditions, including violent and armed confrontations, work outdoors in varying climate conditions.

jobs.title: Event Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role
Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor.
Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader
Key Responsibilities
Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.
  • Supervise event-day execution, ensuring client security needs and account standards are fully met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and coordinate accurate post-event payroll, time processing, and billing data.
  • Act as the primary lead or step in for the Account Manager in their absence.
Staffing, Onboarding & Development
  • Assist with the onboarding, training, scheduling, and distribution of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Deliver pre-event briefings and address large groups (ranging from small teams to 600+ personnel).
  • Evaluate monthly event metrics, staff performance, and employee performance indicators (call-offs, attendance, counseling notes).
  • Coach, mentor, and guide supervisors and staff through personnel issues in accordance with company policy.
Logistics & Equipment Management
  • Manage the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue radios, scanners, and ISS devices.
  • Prepare operational materials, shift rosters, and briefing documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit formal equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of operational needs.
Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations
  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.title: Event Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role
Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor.
Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader
Key Responsibilities
Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.
  • Supervise event-day execution, ensuring client security needs and account standards are fully met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and coordinate accurate post-event payroll, time processing, and billing data.
  • Act as the primary lead or step in for the Account Manager in their absence.
Staffing, Onboarding & Development
  • Assist with the onboarding, training, scheduling, and distribution of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Deliver pre-event briefings and address large groups (ranging from small teams to 600+ personnel).
  • Evaluate monthly event metrics, staff performance, and employee performance indicators (call-offs, attendance, counseling notes).
  • Coach, mentor, and guide supervisors and staff through personnel issues in accordance with company policy.
Logistics & Equipment Management
  • Manage the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue radios, scanners, and ISS devices.
  • Prepare operational materials, shift rosters, and briefing documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit formal equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of operational needs.
Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations
  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.title: Security Branch Manager
jobs.description:
Make a difference, protect lives, and achieve your dreams. Build your career with the industry-leading fire, life safety and security company.

The Security Branch manager is responsible for total branch performance in accordance with company policy and procedures. Create and execute the branch business plan. Ensure store profitability and manage and develop branch personnel. Plan, implement, and manages areas of responsibility to facilitate continuous improvement and personal growth while supporting company goals, missions, and vision. Provide sound leadership for the branch.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Accomplishes department objectives by managing staff, planning, and evaluating department activities.
  • Maintains staff by recruiting, selecting, orienting, and training employees.
  • Ensures a safe, secure, and legal work environment.
  • Develops personal growth opportunities.
  • Accomplishes staff results by communicating job expectations, planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.
  • Coaches, counsels, and disciplines employees.
  • Develops, coordinates, and enforces systems, policies, procedures, and productivity standards.
  • Establishes strategic goals by gathering pertinent business, financial, service, and operations information.
  • Defines objectives, identifies, and evaluates trends and options, chooses a course of action, and evaluates outcomes.
  • Accomplishes financial objectives by forecasting requirements, adhering to an annual budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
  • Maintains quality service by enforcing quality and customer service standards, analyzing, and resolving quality and customer service problems, and recommending system improvements.
  • Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
  • Hiring and Staffing where needed.
  • Customer engagement.
  • Other duties as deemed necessary by company management.

Education/Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or management a plus
  • Three years’ experience in an office setting
  • Permits, Licenses, Certifications a plus
  • Excellent leadership and management skills.
  • Excellent sales, customer service, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, delegating when appropriate.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

Other Duties

  • Adheres to the Code of Conduct, Confidentiality Agreement, and Company Safety Policy.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Benefits And Perks

  • Excellent pay
  • Medical, dental, vision

  • 401K with employer match
  • Paid vacation and company holidays
  • Training and Career Development

jobs.title: Security Officer - PRN
jobs.description:
At Houston Methodist, the Security Officer position is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for patients, staff, and visitors by patrolling and monitoring hospital premises and personnel. This role provides assistance with personal protection, traffic control, and emergency response services, and may employ Houston Methodist-approved defensive tactics to ensure safety.

## Qualifications

A High School diploma or equivalent is required. While criminal justice, security, or related experience is preferred, it is not mandatory. You'll need to obtain a Security Officer state license (either Non

- Commissioned with application within 14 days and license within one year, or Commissioned Level 3 or Personal Protection Officer Level 4). A Texas Driver License must be obtained within 90 days, along with IAHSS certification (Basic/Advanced/Supervisor) within 90 days and Nonviolent Crisis Intervention (CPI) certification within 60 days. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification is preferred.

## Skills and Abilities

We're looking for someone with strong customer service skills who can communicate effectively in English, multitask, and stay calm under pressure. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Webmail, knowledge of Public Safety Policies, and understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality are important. You should also have emergency preparedness knowledge.

## Key Responsibilities

You'll secure premises by patrolling facilities, monitoring surveillance cameras, and controlling access points, including the morgue area. Respond to all radio dispatches, calls, and complaints, providing timely assistance for emergencies. Generate reports by recording occurrences, observations, and witness interviews. Maintain a safe environment by following all safety, hazardous material, emergency preparedness, and HIPAA policies. Prevent loss and damage by reporting irregularities and informing violators of policies. Utilize and maintain equipment per manufacturer specs, and manage time efficiently to assist coworkers when needed.

## Additional Details

This is a PRN (as-needed) position on the day shift. Uniform is required, and you may travel within the Houston Metropolitan area. No on-call duty except during emergencies like disasters or severe weather.

jobs.title: Public Safety Officer Part-Time
jobs.description:
Position Summary 


The Public Safety Officer reports to their assigned Commander-Supervisor. The Public Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of  Lake Forest College designated areas, or community. This role involves protecting students, staff, property, and resources by patrolling, monitoring, and enforcing policies and laws to maintain a secure environment.  


The primary purpose of the Public Safety Officer role is to ensure a safe environment, prevent unauthorized or illegal activities, and support the campus and community by upholding safety standards. This role helps foster a secure and welcoming environment for employees, residents, and visitors. 


The Public Safety Officer patrols assigned areas, responds to emergencies, and enforces rules and regulations. The officer works with the public to provide assistance and ensure a safe environment, upholding professional standards and collaborating with law enforcement as needed. 


Key Responsibilities 


●    Safety Patrols: Conduct routine patrols to deter, observe, and report incidents or safety hazards.


●    Emergency Response: Respond swiftly to emergencies, alarms, and accidents, providing first aid or coordinating with emergency services when necessary.


●    Access Control: Monitor and manage access points to prevent unauthorized entry and ensure security protocols are followed.


●    Incident Investigation: Conduct preliminary investigations, gather information, and report findings by following the chain of command: Commander/Supervisors and in extenuating circumstances notify the Public Safety Director.


●    Public Interaction: Assist and provide information to the public and support community outreach and education on safety practices.


●    Law Enforcement: Ability to communicate and team work with local organizations such as: fire department, police department, city officials and other relevant local authorities.


●    Record Keeping: Maintain accurate logs and reports on patrols, incidents, and daily activities.


●    Vehicle Upkeep:  Responsible for inspecting squad vehicles for each shift member. Ensure that trash is picked up, surfaces are wiped down, and any items left behind are removed. Vehicles will need to remain clean and in orderly conditions. Encourage officers to take pictures, if they observe non-compliance and to report it to the supervisor immediately.  


●    Follow proper vehicle/squad maintenance scheduling. Facilitate information to the Pub Safe accounts payable contact to search for proper billing / invoices / statements to process services payments.


●    Other tasks as assigned.


Working Conditions


●    This is a full-time, non-exempt position with a standard workweek of 32 hours.


●    Officers must be available to workday, evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts, as assigned, to support a 24/7 campus safety operation.


●    The position requires working both indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions, including inclement weather such as rain, snow, and extreme temperatures.


●    Duties may involve extended periods of standing, walking, patrolling on foot or in a vehicle, climbing stairs, and responding quickly to emergency situations.


●    Officers must maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all interactions with students, faculty, staff, and visitors.


Key Skills and Competencies


●    Communication Skills: Clear verbal and written communication abilities.


●    Observation Skills: Keen attention to detail for identifying suspicious activities or hazards.


●    Problem-Solving: Ability to assess situations quickly and make effective decisions under pressure.


●    Conflict Resolution: Skilled in de-escalating situations and managing confrontations calmly.


●    Physical Fitness: Capable of performing physically demanding tasks, such as patrolling, lifting, or restraining individuals.


Requirements


●    Education: High school diploma or equivalent; an associate degree preferred.


●    Coordination role experience prefferred.


●    Ability to collaborate with the team by stepping in to cover any shifts, when needed.


●    Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, GPS tracking, route planning tools, calendaring and internet navigation proficient.


●    Knowledge: Local/state transportation regulations and safety standards.


Physical Requirements


●    Mobility: Frequent walking, standing, and occasional running.


●    Strength: Ability to lift objects or assist individuals in distress.


●    Endurance: Maintain performance during long shifts and in various weather conditions.


Knowledge Requirements


●    Basic knowledge of relevant laws and legal procedures.


●    Safety Protocols: Familiarity with security and emergency response procedures.


●    First Aid and CPR: Knowledge of basic first aid and life-saving techniques.


Coordination and Cooperation Responsibilities


●    Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work with other departments for seamless security and emergency support.


●    Local Cooperation: Coordinate with law enforcement, fire departments, and emergency medical services when needed.


Record and Reporting Responsibilities


●    Detailed Reporting: Write accurate, comprehensive reports on daily activities, incidents, and investigations.


●    Data Management: Maintain security logs and records to support organizational transparency and accountability.


Preferred Qualities


●    Integrity: High ethical standards and reliability.


●    Dependability: Punctuality and accountability in fulfilling job duties.


●    Community Focused: A genuine commitment to public safety on campus and community well-being.


●    Calm Under Pressure: Stays composed in stressful or emergency situations.


Compensation and Benefits:


Part Time 24 hours per week


Hourly Rate of Pay $22.00 per hour


If you are interested in learning more about employment at Lake Forest College, please visit Working at Lake Forest | Lake Forest College.


Benefits information is located at: www.lakeforest.edu/offices-and-departments/human-resources/employee-benefits

jobs.title: Armed Security Officer- 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively.

Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!

Hours

4:00 pm – 12:30 am

    Compensation

    At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $49,040 - $61,300. Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.

    Join Our Team as a Security Officer!

    S&C Electric Company is seeking a dynamic individual to coordinate our security function. As a Security Officer, you’ll be crucial in ensuring smooth operations and supporting our diverse team. Officers perform duties in three main categories, including patrolling the S&C Ridge Boulevard Industrial Campus facility, working in the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), and operating the security gatehouses.

    Key Responsibilities:

    • Utilize strong, written communication skills by creating clear and accurate incident and field activity reports in a timely manner.
    • Conduct and document events/ investigations with close attention to detail; gather and summarize statements and facts for records.
    • Perform routine and scheduled patrols of the S&C Campus to: regulate traffic and parking, ensure team member safety, respond to emergencies/incidents.
    • Act as first responders to critical and emergent situations including: medical emergencies, fires, hazardous material releases/spills, unauthorized personnel on campus, confined space rescues, severe weather, and building evacuations.
    • Certify and maintain required certification in the use of self-contained breathing apparatus and/or respirators.
    • Monitor fire, building supervisory, high-voltage supply, intrusion alarm, and closed-circuit video systems while assigned to the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC).
    • Monitor entry/exit and access to S&C Campus, with attention to detail for guiding team members, vehicles, visitors, and contractors. Maintain accurate logs and records of all commercial-related entrants.
    • Issue temporary identification badges and parking permits to authorized individuals.
    • Coordinate logistics of commercial deliveries and shipments from the GSOC.
    • Operate communication systems by serving as radio dispatchers and telephone switchboard operators during off-hours.
    • Directly identifying and addressing safety, trespassing and workplace violence concerns, which may include, but is not limited to, the detaining of threatening individuals for police resolution.
    • Safely remove unauthorized individuals from the campus using various de-escalation techniques.
    • Maintaining licensing and certifications for essential training and equipment necessary to perform job duties. (PERC, FOID, DL)
    • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
    • Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
    • Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
    • Drive a car or other vehicle.
    • Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules.
      • Other responsibilities as assigned.

    What you’ll Need To Succeed:

    • High School diploma or acceptable General Educational Development (GED), some college preferred.
    • Illinois Driver’s License and Illinois Firearms Owner’s Identification Card.
    • Good verbal and written communication skills; proficiency with personal computers.
    • State of Illinois Security Officer 40-Hour Training Program for armed security
    • A Permanent Employee Registration Card (PERC) and ability to successfully obtain the Firearm Authorization Card (FAC) issued from the State of Illinois, Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.
    • 4 years of security or related background. Industrial security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills
    • Strong computer and technological skills
    • Conflict resolution skills
    • De-escalation and high stress management skills
    • Understanding laws and regulations pertaining to armed security work
      • Understanding signals of distress or impairment in others

    Preferred:

    • Associates Degree in Security, Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, or related field.
    • Any advanced National Incident Management System (NIMS) training.
    • Handcuffing certification.
      • De-escalation training i.e., Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI) or Crisis Intervention (CIT) Training certifications

    Major Physical Demands:

    • Frequently required to stand and perform tasks for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
    • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position and perform desk-based for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
    • Frequently required to walk moderate distances up to [1-2 miles on campus while patrolling] [frequency – e.g., multiple times each day]
    • Occasionally required to solo lift and/or carry items ranging in weight from 5 to 40 lb, and team lift and carry items or other team members to safety, exercising sound judgment to employ manual handling or machine lifts where required and risk assessments, if appropriate.
    • Occasionally required to position self to perform tasks involving but not limited to reaching, twisting, rotating, and pushing/pulling.
    • Occasionally required to use hand-eye coordination to control both hands and arms for a full range of motion to operate equipment/machinery/power tools/office productivity equipment.
    • Frequently ascending or descending ladders/stairs/scaffolding/ramps/poles.
    • Frequently required to observe details at close range, including depth perception, peripheral vision, and the ability to differentiate between colors.
    • Continuously required to talk and hear in person and by phone/conference calls.
      • Frequently required to travel (up to 10%) and work extended hours when necessary.

Medical, dental & vision insurance available! 401K with company matching! Paid vacation & holidays!

ACTS-Aviation Security Inc. has an immediate opening for a Security Agent at the O'Hare International Airport in Chicago, IL.

Established in 2001, ACTS-Aviation Security has grown to become one of the leading providers of security solutions to the US aviation market. ACTS-Aviation Security, Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of the international security company ICTS Europe and specializes in the provision of security solutions and services; primarily focused on catering, aircraft and cargo screening. With corporate offices in Chicago and Atlanta, and operational centers at more than 30 airports across the United States, ACTS provides nationwide coverage. As an ICTS Europe subsidiary, ACTS offers unmatched experience, expertise, quality and innovation. ACTS Security Agents are proud of their role in aviation security and have the opportunity for advancement – the ideal place to build a career in aviation security.

jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Officer Level II (unarmed)

Region/Area: Coppell, TX

Pay: $18-$20/hour depending on Qualifications, WEEKLY PAY

Status: Full-Time Guard


Position Overview
We are currently seeking professional and dependable Unarmed Security Guards for a warehouse located in Coppell, TX. This role is ideal for someone with a strong sense of observation, attention to detail, and a desire to work in a structured, safety-focused environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor security cameras and report any suspicious activity or safety concerns
  • Operate and manage metal detectors and turnstiles to ensure secure access control
  • Conduct routine parking lot checks for compliance
  • Perform assigned safety walks throughout the warehouse to identify and address hazards
  • Maintain a visible presence to deter unauthorized activity
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with site personnel and FRPS supervisors
  • Complete daily reports and incident documentation as required


Compensation:

  • Pay: $18–$20/hour, depending on qualifications
  • 1.5x overtime pay after 40 hours in the same workweek
  • Weekly pay via direct deposit
  • W2 position – taxes withheld


Schedule Hours

Monday -Friday

  • 3:30pm - 11:30pm


Benefits: (Full Time)

  • Employer-paid uniforms
  • Opportunity for advancement and Level III Armed Security training

    • Year 5 and beyond: Up to 15 days (120 hours)

  • Previous security or customer service experience preferred

Preferred Qualities:

  • An ideal candidate is flexible and willing to assist at multiple locations as needed

Overview

Work with the best! Per Mar Security, an industry leader in providing integrated security solutions, is seeking hardworking, motivated people.

Established in 1953, Per Mar Security Services is the largest, family-owned, full-service security company in the Midwest with more than 2,600 team members, operating in 25 branch locations. The company provides full-service security solutions for homes and businesses, including security officer services, smart home automation, burglar and fire alarms, access control, security cameras, alarm monitoring, investigative services, and background checks.

Job Skills / Requirements

Security Officers serve as a safeguard to the client’s premises and a customer service representative, providing escort for vendors and visitors, conducting foot patrols, restricting access as required, and providing general security for the facility. This position is unarmed and not authorized to carry any weapons, ammunition or other protective gear and devices. Pay: $19 to $20 hour

Shift: All shifts. Full Time or Part Time. Must be available to work weekends.

  • Stand guard in a retail setting, directing visitors, issuing access badges, and providing escorts as necessary.
  • Log visitor data and other basic reports in the security computer system.
  • Conduct foot patrols in accordance with post orders.
  • Respond to alarms and emergencies as directed in post orders.
  • Look for and report potential safety hazards.
  • Wear and maintain appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) as outlined for the position and follow all PPE policies and procedures.
  • Follow all client site-specific duties, as required and outlined in post-orders.
  • Work additional hours when necessary – fill open shifts, as needed.
  • Adhere to the highest standards of ethical business conduct and compliance by acting lawfully, ethically, honestly and professionally in the performance of their jobs at all times as well as be in compliance with company policy and procedures as it relates to their job function.
  • Assume responsibility for understanding and complying with Per Mar Security Services attendance expectations.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by interacting with the Per Mar Security Services internal/external customers (including, but not limited to: current customers, prospective customers, clients, vendors, co-workers, supervisors and management.

What you’ll need:

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • State Security Officer License
  • Valid driver’s license and a good driving record.

  • Load product on shipments and shuttles to insure scheduled load times are being met by our facility and the warehouse along with scheduled delivery time of product.
  • Process customer returns and validate all incoming product.
  • Use, know and understand all computer programs and technical skills used at the facility in the shipping and inventory function.

  • Unpack deliveries; verify product received against PO item and quantity. Receive items in SAP. Pull PO (or reprint) and assemble w/packing slip for GR for 3-way filing.

jobs.title: Package Handler
jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic team as a Package Handler and become an essential part of our fast-paced warehouse operations! In this energetic role, you will be responsible for efficiently handling, loading, unloading, and organizing packages to ensure timely delivery and smooth logistics flow. Your proactive approach and attention to detail will help maintain safety standards and optimize warehouse productivity. This paid position offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in warehouse distribution, heavy equipment operation, and inventory management while contributing to a thriving logistics environment.

Duties

  • Safely load and unload packages using appropriate equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, clamp trucks, and RF scanners
  • Accurately pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment following specified procedures
  • Operate heavy equipment including cranes and material handling equipment to move large or heavy items efficiently
  • Maintain organized storage areas by stacking pallets and managing inventory with precision using inventory management systems
  • Follow safety protocols in accordance with OSHA regulations to prevent accidents and ensure a secure working environment
  • Assist with shipping and receiving tasks, verifying shipments against documentation and inspecting packages for damage or discrepancies
  • Support warehouse operations by performing manual handling tasks such as heavy lifting and load & unload activities

Requirements

  • Prior experience in warehouse distribution or warehouse operations is highly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to operate material handling equipment including forklifts, clamp trucks, pallet jacks, and cranes; certifications are a plus
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, shipping & receiving procedures, and materials handling techniques
  • Basic math skills for counting, measuring, and verifying quantities accurately
  • Experience with RF scanners or other warehouse technology tools is advantageous
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks involving heavy lifting safely and efficiently
  • Knowledge of safety protocols aligned with OSHA standards to promote a safe work environment
  • Warehouse experience or supervisor experience is beneficial for growth opportunities in the role

This position is ideal for motivated individuals eager to thrive in a bustling warehouse setting. We’re committed to supporting your professional development while ensuring you work in a safe, engaging environment. Join us today and be part of a team that values energy, precision, and safety!

Pay: $24.85 - $29.93 per hour

Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Relocation assistance

jobs.title: Entry-Level Security Officer – Training Provided
jobs.description:
Entry-Level Security Officer – Training ProvidedJob Description

ORN Security Solutions is looking for dependable people who are interested in starting a career in the private security industry.

No previous security experience is required.

In fact, we're specifically interested in people who are willing to learn. If you've thought about working in security but didn't know how to get started, this may be a good opportunity to get your foot in the door.

This is an entry-level position starting at $14.00 per hour. Both full-time and part-time schedules are available.

We want to be upfront about the starting wage. We're looking for people who want an opportunity to learn the profession, gain real-world experience, and potentially advance into positions with greater responsibility as they gain experience and additional licensing.

What You'll Do

This is a professional security position. Depending on your assigned shift, responsibilities may include:

  • Monitoring entrances and access points
  • Observing activity on the property
  • Conducting routine foot or property patrols as assigned
  • Helping maintain a safe and orderly environment
  • Professionally interacting with employees, visitors and members of the public
  • Identifying and reporting unusual or suspicious activity
  • Completing basic written activity and incident reports when necessary
  • Following site procedures and instructions
  • Contacting supervisors or emergency services when appropriate

This is not a law-enforcement position. We emphasize observation, professionalism, communication, documentation and good judgment.

What We're Looking For

Experience isn't our biggest concern. Reliability is.

We're looking for people who:

  • Show up when they're scheduled
  • Arrive on time
  • Have reliable transportation
  • Can communicate professionally
  • Can remain alert and attentive during a shift
  • Are comfortable working independently
  • Can follow instructions and established procedures
  • Are willing to learn
  • Take pride in their appearance and professionalism
  • Can meet the requirements to work legally in the Texas private security industry

New to Security? That's Okay.

Everybody in this industry started somewhere.

We're a locally owned DFW security company, and we're willing to work with the right people who have the attitude and reliability we're looking for.

We'll help you understand the job, learn professional security practices, and gain actual experience in the field. For employees interested in making security a career, there may also be opportunities to pursue additional training, licensing and greater responsibility as our company grows.

We would rather find a dependable person with the right attitude and teach them than hire someone with years of experience who doesn't take the job seriously.

Position Details

Pay: $14.00 per hour
Job Types: Full-time and Part-time
Location: Dallas, Texas
Experience: No previous security experience required

About ORN Security Solutions

ORN Security Solutions is a locally owned Dallas-Fort Worth security company providing professional security and patrol services throughout the area.

We believe good security starts with dependable people, professional conduct and doing the job the right way.

If you're looking for an opportunity to enter the security profession and you're willing to show up, learn and work, we'd like to hear from you.

ORN Security Solutions
Defend. Deter. Deliver.

jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic warehouse team as a Forklift Operator and Warehouse Worker, where you'll play a vital role in maintaining efficient warehouse operations. This energetic position offers the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art equipment, support inventory management, and ensure the safe handling of materials. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about safety and precision, this is your chance to contribute to a thriving logistics operation that values your skills and dedication.

Responsibilities

  • Operate various types of material handling equipment including forklifts, reach trucks, Hi-Lo, clamp trucks, pallet jacks, and barcode scanners to load, unload, and move products safely and efficiently.
  • Perform order picking using manual methods or order picker equipment to fulfill customer orders accurately and promptly.
  • Manage inventory by conducting regular stock counts, updating warehouse management systems (WMS), and ensuring proper storage of materials.
  • Assist with shipping and receiving tasks by verifying shipments against documentation, preparing goods for dispatch, and maintaining accurate inbound/outbound logs.
  • Conduct routine equipment inspections and perform basic repairs or coordinate maintenance to ensure all machinery operates safely according to OSHA standards.
  • Follow warehouse safety protocols including OSHA regulations, forklift safety standards, manual handling procedures, and heavy equipment operation guidelines to prevent accidents.
  • Support warehouse distribution activities by organizing storage areas, optimizing space utilization, and ensuring compliance with safety standards in production environments.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience operating forklifts (including reach trucks, Hi-Lo, clamp trucks) and other material handling equipment such as pallet jacks and lift trucks.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse management systems (WMS), barcode scanning for logistics, shipping & receiving procedures, and inventory management practices.
  • Knowledge of warehouse safety standards including OSHA regulations related to forklift operation, manual handling, heavy lifting, and general warehouse safety protocols.
  • Ability to perform heavy lifting consistently while adhering to manual handling best practices.
  • Basic math skills for inventory counts and order accuracy verification.
  • Prior experience in warehouse operations or distribution centers is highly preferred; warehouse supervisor experience is a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational skills for managing multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Join us in creating a safe, efficient, and energetic workplace where your skills make a real difference!

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Security Officer Armed - Security
jobs.via: via Women For Hire- Job Board
jobs.description:
Description

Summary:

Uniformed position at all times. Armed Security Officer’s duties include being a visible deterrent to criminal activity, providing security for patients, Associates, and visitors, protecting and patrolling hospital buildings, assets and premises as assigned. The Armed Security Officer is responsible for responding to all emergency codes, internal/external disaster events as needed and/or requested, conducting preliminary investigations of reported incidents, and performing other security related tasks as directed by a security supervisor/and or Manager. The Armed Security Officer must have flexibility in hours and be able to rotate between facilities including travel whenever necessary. CHRISTUS Approved uniforms must be worn in accordance with dress code requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Meets expectations of the applicable OneCHRISTUS Competencies: Leader of Self, Leader of Others, or Leader of Leaders.
  • Conducts frequent security patrols of the facilities and grounds as assigned.
  • Identifies and reports trends related to security issues. Recommends actions.
  • Takes initial information for an incident report, uses proper grammar, spelling, punctuation, notes only the facts, leaving out personal opinions and submits report in a timely manner (no later than the end of assigned shift).
  • Responds promptly to all service requests relayed by supervisor, telephone, pass-on, e-mail, radio, cell phone and other correspondence in a courteous and expeditious manner.
  • Responds to the collection, inventory and return of lost and found items, patient valuables, and personal property according to policy.
  • Enforces all rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of CHRISTUS Health and the laws of the state in which CHRISTUS is doing business.
  • Controls and enforces facility parking using patrols, violation warning citations, towing, booting and explanation of rules as applicable.
  • Assists clinical/non-clinical Associates with combative patients or visitors.
  • Demonstrates competence to perform assigned client care responsibilities in a way that meets the age-specific and developmental needs of persons served by the department.
  • Demonstrates proficiency and knowledge in the operation of the Attendant Console, Paging System, security radio/dispatch system, operations of the Digital Video Recorder (NVR) security monitors (CCTV) and the general overhead paging system.
  • Must be proficient with the use of a PC to generate electronic daily activity security reports, incident reports, emails and other applicable electronic correspondence during the performance of duties.
  • Promotes a safe environment by reporting safety hazards observed (broken water/sprinkler lines, burned out internal/external lighting, smoke/gas odors, tripping hazards, etc.) during the performance of security rounds.
  • Appropriately adapts assigned client assessment, treatment and/or care methods to accommodate the physical, cultural, age-specific, and other developmental needs of each person served.
  • Demonstrated competence with handgun, hand cuffs, baton, non-crisis intervention certification and two-way radios.
  • Frequent exposure to aggressive behavior and emotionally charged situations.
  • Occasional exposure to hazardous conditions such as fires, chemical spills, and flooding.
  • Frequent exposure to heat and cold from external weather conditions.
  • Long periods of walking, standing, stooping, and lifting.
  • Must be physically fit and able to walk all areas of the facilities and grounds, to restrain those who need restraint and be able to assist nursing staff with lifting patients of all sizes.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Must be always mentally alert.
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be able to make immediate decisions regarding laws, policies, and procedures.
  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks and prioritize.
  • Must be able to handle personal stress and possible violence.

Job Requirements:

Education/Skills

  • High School Diploma or its equivalent required

Experience

  • Minimum two (2) years of armed security experience (may substituted by Honorable Military Service) preferred
  • Law enforcement experience preferred
  • Healthcare security experience preferred

Licenses, Registrations, or Certifications

  • Verbal De-escalation training must be completed within 60 days of hire
  • BLS required within 60 days of hire
  • Expandable Baton training, defensive tactics training, firearms training, weapon qualification, and firearms retention training must be completed prior to letter of authorization to carry is issued
  • Successful completion of all pre-employment and post offer assessments to include the Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Inventory -2 (MMPI-2-RF-PCIR); the California Psychological Inventory (CPI); the Police and Public Safety Selection Report (PPSSR); the Personal Experience Inventory (PEI) and a clinical interview by a third personal psychologist
  • Will be required to take random drug test screening
  • Valid Driver's license required
  • Candidates must maintain an acceptable driving record to meet CHRISTUS Health standards for positions requiring driving. An unacceptable record includes, but is not limited to:
    • One or more moving violations within a 12-month period.
    • One or more chargeable accidents within a 12-month period. Chargeable means the driver is determined to be the primary cause of the accident.
    • Contributing factors such as weather or mechanical issues will be considered.
    • Any combination of accidents and/or moving violations.
    • Violations include any ticket, charge, or other law enforcement proceeding related to these, as well as independent evidence of violations deemed relevant by CHRISTUS Health Security.
  • For Texas positions:
    • Must hold an active Level 3 Commission with the Texas Department of Public Safety Private Security Bureau (TDPSPSB).
    • New hires who have completed the TDPSPSB security commission course must obtain their commission prior to hire.
    • If the license status is ACTIVE in TOPS and the pocket card has not yet been received, the licensee may begin working.
    • Until the pocket card is received, the licensee must carry proof of ACTIVE status (e.g., screenshot or printed copy from TOPS) while on duty.
  • For New Mexico positions:
    • Officers may not carry a weapon on duty until completing 40 hours of training and receiving a letter of authorization from the CHRISTUS Vice President of Security to carry a CHRISTUS Health-assigned weapon.
  • For Louisiana positions:
    • Officers may not carry a weapon on duty until completing 40 hours of training and receiving a letter of authorization from the CHRISTUS Vice President of Security to carry a CHRISTUS Health-assigned weapon.

In accordance with the CHRISTUS Health License, Certification and Registration Verification Policy, all Associates are required to obtain the required certifications for their respective positions within the designated time frame.

Work Schedule:

6AM - 6PM 12 HR Shift

Work Type:

Full Time

The position of a Package Handler is integral to the operational flow of logistics, entailing the secure and efficient transport of packages within the facility. Your core duties comprise physically moving packages, loading and unloading shipments, sorting items, scanning for monitoring purposes, and prepping packages for dispatch accurately. Benefits of Package Handler:

Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision after 90 days, Paid Parental Leave (Moms & Dads), and Employee Assistance Programs.

Security Officer Level 3, San Antonio, TX

What You Will Do

Our Security Officers protect the Industrial or Commercial property of our clients against fire, vandalism and illegal entry.

Our clients range from Class-A Office Buildings, Luxury Residential Properties, Distilleries, Fortune 500 Companies, Financial Institutions, Telecommunications, Manufacturing/Industrial Factories, Hospitals and many others.

Same Day Offers: interview with the hiring team and receive an offer to join us the same day!

  • Extensive Training: Our initial training paves the way for you to earn your Security Officer Certification. Walden Security has been recognized by Training Magazine as a Top 100 Award Winner which is awarded to companies with the most successful learning and development programs in the world!
  • Unbelievable PERKS!: Save on phone, vacation, auto, retailers and more!
  • Tuition Reimbursement: we believe in the professional development of our team members and provide annual reimbursement opportunities.
  • Employee Family Scholarship: To date, Walden Security has awarded more than $300,000 in Employee Family Scholarships!
  • Paid Time Off: offered to employees that average at least 32 hours per week
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance: multiple plan options for you and your dependents
  • Health Savings Account: pay for health care more easily
  • Voluntary Life Insurance: affordable plans available
  • 401K: prepare for your retirement
  • Employee Assistance Program: we offer free, confidential assistance for many of your life’s needs
  • Employee Recognition Programs: we believe in celebrating the “wins” with our Walden Security team. We reward the hard work and dedication of our employees through Tenure Recognition, On-The-Spot Bonuses, Officer of the Month and Officer of the Year recognitions which include awards and bonuses
  • Culture of Caring: Walden Security supports many charitable organizations
  • Award Winning Company: Walden Security has earned significant recognition for our better working environment for our officers, better service to our customers and a dedication to quality performance standards.
  • Promote From Within Philosophy: Walden Security offers growth opportunities for our team members who are Setting the Standard by Setting the Example
  • Flexible Schedules: We offer flexible scheduling with multiple shifts available includingFirst, Second, Third and Weekend Shifts
  • Competitive Pay!

Pay Rate

$20.50 - $20.50 USD

We offer every employee — from executive managers to administrative support to security professionals — unique and generous benefits, as well as opportunities for career growth.

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey.Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiringprocess or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in aconfidential file.

As set forth in Walden Security’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy,we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

If you believe you belong to any of the categories of protected veterans listed below, please indicate by making the appropriate selection.As a government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA), we request this information in order to measurethe effectiveness of the outreach and positive recruitment efforts we undertake pursuant to VEVRAA. Classification of protected categoriesis as follows:

A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.

A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.

An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.

An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at www.dol.gov/ofccp .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis...

jobs.description:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Uphold all safety regulations and procedures to ensure workplace security.
  • Attendance in safety training seminars is crucial for mastering the techniques required for working efficiently in a busy warehouse environment.
  • Wrap, transport, and send merchandise to customers and retail establishments.
  • Ensure the meticulous handling of goods for store shipment and guest drop-offs.
  • Facilitate the movement of freight and optimize inventory operations within the warehouse.
  • Ensure your workspace is clean, well-maintained, and devoid of clutter.

  • Physical ability for standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching during assigned periods.
  • Keep a proactive and capable attitude while engaged in group work or working autonomously.
  • Fundamental numerical operations, such as counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Skill in accurately interpreting and understanding labels, tickets, and other product documentation.
  • Operate computer systems or handheld devices independently and effectively once adequately trained.
  • Demonstrating adeptness in spoken and written interactions.
