Builders Supply, A CRH company, is a leading supplier of ready mixed concrete, reinforcing steel, and building materials in Louisiana. Our focus is to provide quality products and reliable customer service with a safety-first mindset. We consider our employees our greatest strength and we make it our priority to invest in their development and well-being. When you work for Builders Supply, you are helping to support and build the infrastructure of Louisiana.

Diesel Mechanic

Under the immediate direction of the Senior Mechanic, the Diesel Mechanic performs repairs on mobile equipment, including ready mix trucks, front end loaders, and trailers. 60/40 work split between Shop and mobile repairs at Concrete Ready Mix plants.

Requirements

  • Observes and listens to truck in operation to determine malfunctions.
  • Use diagnostic software to do advanced troubleshooting
  • Reads manuals, uses hand tools, power tools to perform repairs and maintenance to electrical systems, power transmissions, brakes, drivelines and other automotive systems to perform repair work
  • Replaces rollers and other wear items as required
  • Performs welding, repair and fabrication
  • Assists Senior Mechanic as needed
  • Performs data entry on all services performed
  • Operates mobile equipment as needed
  • Delivers technical advice to Ready Mix Truck Drivers and other mobile equipment operators.
  • Maintains parts inventory and orders of parts and supplies as needed
  • Demonstrates good knowledge of lock out/tag out procedure required during certain procedures
  • May make service calls at other plants or emergency roadside repairs as needed
  • Assists with training co-workers as needed
  • General clean-up of work areas
  • Follows safety policies and procedures as written
  • Participates in the shop safety program and conduct tailgate safety meeting.
  • Performs other duties as required

Preferred Education and Experience

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent GED required
  • Minimum 2 years Mobile Equipment Maintenance Experience, Ready Mix Maintenance experience preferred
  • Trade School or related mechanical / technical certification
  • Commercial Driver License (CDL) and safe driving record

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of repair and maintenance of diesel engines, hydraulics, electrical, transmissions, brakes, drivelines and other automotive systems to perform repair work
  • Basic welding skills
  • Ability to read and write in English
  • 40 hours per week and overtime on an as needed basis

Physical Requirements

  • Work requires the ability to lift a maximum 100 lbs
  • Work requires the ability to climb stairs, climb ladders, reach, squat, tolerate prolonged standing/walking, balance, bend from trunk, operate mobile equipment, crawl, kneel, push and pull objects
  • Work requires the ability to operate hand controls with both hands and foot pedals with both feet
  • Work requires the ability to perform sustained overhead reaching
  • Work requires the ability to use vibration tools
  • Work requires the ability to perform work white lying on back tar for prolonged periods of time and in some cases cramped quarters
  • Work requires the ability to work in areas with the potential for high noise levels
  • Work is performed 50% outdoors in all environmental temperatures and weather and 50% indoors

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. High-Profile Class A Commercial Property

Position: Security Site Supervisor

Schedule: Monday – Friday | 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM

Compensation: $16.00 - 17.50

United Protective Services is seeking an experienced, professional, and motivated Security Site Supervisor to assist daily security operations at a Class A commercial property. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who thrives in a leadership role, values exceptional customer service.

The ideal candidate is a confident leader with strong organizational and computer skills who can effectively supervise officers, maintain operational excellence, and foster positive relationships with both clients and tenants.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Supervise and lead the daily operations of the onsite security team.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and accountability to security officers while promoting a positive team culture.
  • Ensure officers are properly trained, professional in appearance, and consistently meeting performance expectations.
  • Deliver outstanding customer service to property management, tenants, visitors, and vendors.
  • Monitor daily operations to ensure all patrols, inspections, and assigned tasks are completed accurately and on time.
  • Review, approve, and maintain Daily Activity Reports (DARs), incident reports, and other security documentation.
  • Utilize security software and Microsoft Office applications to complete administrative responsibilities and maintain accurate records.
  • Coordinate closely with Property Management and company leadership regarding security operations, incidents, staffing, and special projects.
  • Respond to emergencies, security incidents, and customer concerns in a professional and decisive manner.
  • Conduct routine property inspections to identify safety hazards, maintenance concerns, and security vulnerabilities.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of security experience required.
  • Previous security supervisory or leadership experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience supervising security personnel in a commercial office environment preferred.
  • Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and the ability to learn security reporting software.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven leadership abilities with a strong focus on coaching, accountability, and team development.
  • Exceptional customer service and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Valid driver's license with reliable transportation.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be:

  • A strong and approachable leader.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Professional, dependable, and accountable.
  • Customer-focused with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confident in making decisions and leading by example.
  • Committed to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and operational excellence.

Why Join United Protective Services?

  • Monday through Friday schedule with weekends off.
  • Leadership opportunity at a premier commercial property.
  • Stable, long-term assignment.
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement.
  • Supportive leadership team and professional work environment.

If you're ready to lead a team, provide exceptional customer service, and make a meaningful impact at one of San Antonio's premier commercial properties, we encourage you to apply today.


At United Protective Services, our people are our greatest asset. We are looking for reliable, positive people who want to serve others, and grow in their security careers. In return, we provide training, support, and opportunities you need to succeed.

jobs.title: National Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Join Allied Universal® Technology Services, a global leader in transforming the security industry. We integrate advanced technology — video surveillance, electronic access control, alarm monitoring and augmented solutions with physical security to help people feel safe. Whether you’re an installation technician, service technician, engineer, or project manager, you’ll discover rewarding opportunities to grow your career as part of a valued team.

Apply today and be phenomenal—build a meaningful career while protecting what matters most through innovative security technology.

Job Description

Allied Universal Technology Services is hiring a National Project Manager. The Project Manager will play a key role in delivering cutting-edge electronic security solutions. In this position, you’ll provide project-delivery leadership across a portfolio of geographically dispersed projects and complex electronic security and related construction programs, driving initiatives from start to finish. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about delivering results, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and support Project Managers and field leaders while reinforcing accountability, disciplined planning, reporting, escalation, quality, and financial performance
  • Oversee portfolio-level delivery across geographically dispersed electronic security and related construction projects
  • Monitor project health, site execution, client commitments, contractual requirements, and program objectives
  • Maintain schedule visibility, validate milestones and dependencies, and drive recovery plans for critical-path risks
  • Share fiscal responsibility for revenue, cost, margin, forecasts, billing, change orders, collections exposure, and financial risk
  • Identify cross-project trends, systemic risks, and distressed projects; assign owners, actions, due dates, and escalation paths
  • Track long-lead equipment, material constraints, procurement risks, substitutions, delivery issues, and subcontractor performance
  • Audit quality compliance, review recurring defects, verify corrective actions, and support critical commissioning and acceptance testing
  • Ensure client standards, specifications, bulletins, and technical direction are incorporated into project execution
  • Provide timely status visibility to program leadership, client stakeholders, and cross-functional teams while serving as a senior escalation point

Qualifications (must Have)

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
  • Minimum of three (3) years of project management, engineering, construction, electronic security or field service experience
  • Minimum of one (1) year of experience managing project financials, to include budgets, P&L, labor and material costs, margin, billing, change orders and collections
  • Experience managing multiple projects (portfolio) of at least $1M, while working independently and meeting deadlines
  • Working knowledge of electronic security systems, including access control, CCTV/electronic surveillance, intrusion detection, system integration, testing, and installation quality requirements
  • Advanced knowledge of project planning and scheduling, financial management, forecasting, change control, risk management, procurement, subcontractor management, quality management, commissioning, and project closeout
  • Proficient with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project, and SharePoint)
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to build strong relationships internally and externally, and ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%, with potential to travel internationally

Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)

  • Associate’s or Bachelor's Degree in Project Management, Construction, Engineering, Business or a related field
  • Solid knowledge of PM techniques and tools, general knowledge of contract laws and regulations
  • Experience managing electronic-security projects within mission-critical, data-center, or similarly demanding construction environments
  • Knowledge of project management software (e.g., PM Workbench, MS Project, Procore, Bluebeam) and ERP systems
  • PMP, CSPM, CAPM or equivalent project management certification

Benefits

    • Pay: $100,000 - $125,000 annually + company vehicle + gas card + 4% quarterly bonus potential + 4% annual bonus potential
    • Medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
    • Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days
    • Vacation time offered at an accrual rate of 3.08 hours biweekly. Unused vacation is only paid out where required by law
Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

Part Time Overnight Security Officer job at The Beeman Hotel. Dallas, TX.

Job Description

Job Description

Description:

MONDAY AND TUESDAY Availability REQUIRED

$18/HR

A Safety & Security Guard is responsible for providing protection for hotel guests employees and property. They are also responsible for providing guests with a sense of comfort and well being by maintaining a level of visibility.

Responsibilities

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School diploma or equivalent and/or experience in a hotel or a related field preferred
  • Certificate of Completion in Safety and Security Training
  • CPR First Aid and Heimlich maneuver Certified

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Approach all encounters with guests and employees in a friendly service oriented manner.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Coury Hospitality standards as required by scheduling which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming which include wearing the proper uniform when working (per brand standards)
  • Comply at all times with Coury Hospitality standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.
  • Answer phone and dispatch in a timely manner in addition to demonstrating proper two-way radio etiquette at all times when communicating with other Associates; maintain radio contact with the Front Desk/Night Auditor at all times.
  • Maintain visual contact with the Front Desk/Night Auditor and the front door of the hotel by remaining in the Lobby area when not on property walks.
  • Maintain and review daily activity log.
  • Maintain confidentiality with respect to guest and Associate incidents.
  • Hold briefing with Guest Services staff both at the beginning and end of shift.
  • Open secured areas for authorized personnel; checks ID of visitors/Associates as necessary.
  • Maintain an awareness of legal limitations of position (i.e. local ordinances state ordinances etc.).
  • Assist guests to their rooms or help guests enter their rooms.
  • Investigates room thefts auto accidents/thefts and assault complaints for guests (not for Associates); serves as the first responder partnering with Department Head/Hotel leadership to write the incident report.
  • Assist outside agencies as necessary.
  • Provide escort.
  • Assist HR/MOD with responding to Associate altercations.
  • Assist with intoxicated guests.
  • Be knowledgeable about hotel and guestroom locking systems.
  • Respond to security alarms and monitor TV cameras (CCTV) (if applicable).
  • Challenge suspicious persons.
  • Conduct rounds checking for safety hazards checking lights and door locks and picking up items left on the property.
  • Assist during medical emergencies administering First Aid/C.P.R/Heimlich maneuver as necessary.
  • In partnership with Department Head/Hotel leadership completes Incident/Accident Reports in a clear and concise manner.
  • Receive deliveries; deliver requested items to guest rooms as needed.
  • Assist with handling items for “Lost and Found” according to the standards.
  • Works special functions attends meetings and/or performs other duties as required.
Property Details

The Beeman Hotel includes an indoor swimming pool. Dallas Love Field airport, just 6 miles away.

Unique décor and modern furnishings are showcased in each guest room at the Beeman Hotel. All rooms are appointed with free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV and a coffee machine.

Fax and photocopy services as well as internet access are available in the hotel’s 24-hour business center. The on-site fitness facilities are fitted with a full set of cardio machines.

Position Type: Part Time

Join Our Team at Blue Skies of Texas Senior Living Community!

Become a part of our independent living experience. At Blue Skies, we're not just about providing exceptional care; we're about creating a vibrant, diverse community where everyone thrives. Where your unique talents and perspectives are not only valued but recognized. Blue Skies is a community where your contributions make a real difference, without the worry of late-night shifts. From engaging activities to personalized care, we're dedicated to empowering both our residents and our staff to live their best lives.

We are committed to providing our team with the support they need. At Blue Skies of Texas, we offer medical, dental, and vision benefits! Some of our unique benefits we offer are:

Employee Assistance Program

Employee Referral Bonus Program

A generous PTO program

Employee Appreciation Bonus (twice a year)

We are looking for dedicated professionals like yourself to be a part of our Resident Services team.

What you will do in this role: Makes interior and exterior rounds of Blue Skies of Texas facilities and grounds, either walking or driving company vehicle or golf cart, to include checking basic plant mechanical operations such as ensuring the boiler is operational; promptly reports any deficiencies to Supervisor, management and the Maintenance Department

Observes and responds to the presence of unauthorized persons or vehicles; investigates and acts according to standard procedures outlined by Supervisor.

Directs and controls traffic and parking for large functions.

Transports residents, employees, and others, as directed, from place of request to main building as needed.

Acts as First Responder and responds to problems and emergencies according to established instructions and procedures; exercises good judgment as the situation requires.

Expedites entry and departure of emergency vehicles and responds to emergencies as prescribed in the Emergency Action Book.

Submits comprehensive incident reports of any non-routine events occurring during shift.

Consults with Supervisor on any situation involving exception to policies or procedures.

Regulates access to Blue Skies of Texas facilities by vehicles and persons on foot entering the premises at the main gate; follows directions given by resident, Supervisor, or management regarding restricted entry or expected arrival of guests.

Issues “visitor passes” as appropriate and maintains a log of entry and departure of all visitors.

Informs residents and staff of the arrival of visitors or guests.

Operates gate when appropriate.

Performs security checks of vehicles and of employee personal items in accordance with Blue Skies of Texas policy, to include purchases made at Blue Skies of Texas and Thrift Stores.

Makes minor repairs such as unstopping toilets or sinks, resetting smoke detectors and replacing batteries, changing light bulbs, etc., when maintenance personnel are not on duty.

Performs duties as a Front Desk Clerk as needed.

Performs other duties as assigned by Supervisor.

QualificationsQualifications: Required: High school diploma or equivalent.

Required: At least one years worth of experience as a Security Guard, Courtesy Officer, or Front Desk Clerk preferred.

Required: Must possess a current, valid Texas drivers license with good driving record and remain insurable by Blue Skies carriers required.

Required: Possess current cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), automated external defibrillator (AED), and First Aid certifications is required.

In 1970, the first of our two campuses opened in San Antonio. Air Force Village I was followed in 1987 by Air Force Village II. For decades, our campuses created a community for officers of the armed forces - a retirement lifestyle rich with camaraderie and the shared common bond. We began by providing support to the widows of those who have served, and that legacy continues. In 2014, we expanded our eligibility to embrace a wider range of retired seniors, including those from civilian careers. With this change, a new name - Blue Skies of Texas - was added, and the campuses were renamed Blue Skies East and Blue Skies West. Continuing to offer modern residences and a range of senior-focused services and amenities, the Air Force Village legacy we cherish carries forward in Blue Skies of Texas.

jobs.description:
Date Posted:

2026-07-27

Country:

United States of America

Location:

US-TX-RICHARDSON-461 ~ 3200 E Renner Rd ~ RENNER BLDG 461

Position Role Type:

Onsite

U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date.​ U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance​

Security Clearance Type:

DoD Clearance: Top Secret

Security Clearance Status:

Active and existing security clearance required on day 1

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Manager, Contractor Special Access Program Security Officer (CSSO), you will be responsible for the management of accredited SAPFs and SCIFs, manage all security aspects of classified government contract programs and operations, lead self-inspections and security education programs to ensure security compliance, and work with internal and external partners to determine a mitigation strategy for any instances of non-compliance.

Implement all requisite national security directives with specific emphasis on DoD 5205.07 SAP Security Manual, ICD 705 and exhibit the dedication and expectation of a seasoned security professional while working and making decisions independently without direct supervision.


** This is an onsite position in Richardson, TX. **

What YOU will do:

  • Professionally and effectively interface with program managers and government officials to obtain rulings, interpretations, and acceptable deviations or waivers for compliance with regulations.

  • Implement and ensure compliance with the DoD Manual 5205.07, 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM Rule), Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs), and related Industrial Security Guidance Manuals or Special Program Security directives.

  • Make decisions and provide timely inputs that impact critical goals and objectives of the business.

  • Review contractual (SOW, CDRL, etc.) documents, internal directives, and external customer directives for security applicability, impact analysis, and make recommendations to Program Management.

  • Perform duties as the SAP-AO (Accountability Officer).

  • Provide oversight of security related Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), OPSEC Plans,

  • Program Protection Plans (PPP), Program Protection Implementation Plans (PPIP).

  • Partner with cross functional organizations to support business objectives.

  • Implement a self-inspection program to include evaluating findings and directing the implementation and re-evaluation of the corrective action(s).

  • Prepare, submit and receive area/facility accreditation approvals

  • Lead the team in Government security compliance inspections.
    Investigate security infractions/violations, prepare reports specifying the potential for loss or compromise, and provide associated corrective actions.

  • Collaborate with and assist the ISSO/ISSM on implementation of JSIG requirements and approved sanitization procedures for hardware and test equipment.

  • Participate in facility construction meetings, build out, and documentation (if applicable) 

  • This position may work extended hours and weekends. Local travel throughout North Texas may be required. Other travel may be required on a limited basis.

Qualifications YOU Must Have:

  • Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience.

  • U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

  • Active and transferable U.S. government issued Top Secret security clearance is required prior to start date.

  • Experience specifically with implementing SAP & SCI security compliance.

  • Willingness to perform security tasks outside specialty (e.g. physical security) and be proficient in Microsoft Applications (Word, Excel, Power Point, ).

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, computer, and writing skills. The ability to perform in a unique multi-program environment.

  • Understanding of customer SAP security and acquisition structures.
    DISS, JADE, JWICS and Scattered Castles user experience.

  • Ability to plan, schedule, and arrange activities in accomplishing objectives.

  • Ability to develop and implement solutions to a variety of complex problems.

  • Membership in professional organizations (CSSWG, ASIS, etc.) and professional certifications.

  • Experience with Basis of Estimates (BOEs) for existing work and contract bids

  • TS/SCI Clearance.

What We Offer:

Some of our competitive benefits packages include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees.

  • Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate. employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option.

  • Tuition reimbursement program.

  • Student Loan Repayment Program.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection.

  • Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits.

  • Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning.

  • Adoption Assistance.

  • Autism Benefit.

  • Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions.

  • Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program.

  • Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits.

  • Bright Horizons, child, and elder care services.

  • Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program.

  •  And more! 

Learn More & Apply Now!

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customers succeed today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

WE ARE REDEFINING...

If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

Position responsible for assisting with the protecting, securing and promoting safety and security at a Memorial Hermann Hospital campus.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: High School Diploma or GED

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Must be licensed as a Commissioned Security Officer by the Texas Department of Public Safety Private Security Bureau (if not licensed upon date of hire, must obtain license no more than 90 days after hire);

  • Possession of a valid driver’s license (if from out of state, must obtain a Texas Driver’s license within 90 days of employment);

  • Must be certified in Heartsaver® CPR or Heartcode BLS CPR by the American Heart Association (if not certified upon date of hire, must obtain certification no more than 90 days after hire);

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Age Requirement: Must be at least 21 years of age.

  • Minimum of one (1) year security related experience required.

  • Healthcare experience preferred.

  • Must be able to understand the English language and communicate it effectively in both verbal and written form.

  • Proficiency in the use of computers is required.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitors assigned areas in a manner assuring maximum visibility of the security presence; post in assigned area or conduct patrols in vehicle or on foot; serving to ensure security of all designated areas and access points; control vehicular access to buildings and parking areas; identify and report all fire and safety hazards, suspicious activities, or breaches of security.

  • Controls access of areas and of materials by administering and enforcing building visitor and materials pass programs. Have a complete understanding of hospital, building management, and departmental policies and procedures; post orders and comply with their job requirements at all times.

  • Responds to all security and emergency situations as dispatched or assigned; assist patients, visitors and staff by answering questions and by providing escorts, directions, and vehicle assists.

  • Completes and submits required Security Reports and activity logs within assigned shift; properly operate and care for Security equipment; maintain knowledge of locations and operation of emergency systems and equipment.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned.

21+ Years of Age

Allied Universal®, North America's leading security and facility services company, provides rewarding careers that give you a sense of purpose. We offer medical, dental and vision coverage, life insurance, retirement plan, employee assistance programs, company discounts, perks and more for most full-time positions!

Work for the leader in Security

Full Time, Excellent Benefits, Career Progression!

Daily Pay - Our new tool that gives employees a say in when they get paid...the choice is yours!

**COVID-19 vaccination is required for this position - the Company will provide accommodations asrequired by law for disability and religious-based reasons

As a Hospital Security Officer, you will serve and safeguard a high profile healthcare customer. The Hospital Security Officer is responsible for the surveillance of the client's healthcare premises and the protection of the staff, members, and visitors. A Hospital Security Professional detects and prevents any suspicious activity, observe and reports incidents, and provides customer service in a friendly and professional manner.

Responsibilities:

  • Observe and remain vigilant for signs of crime, disorder, hazard, and unusual activity
  • Patrol on foot, bicycle, or via a vehicle to check for unsafe conditions, blocked entryways, security violations, mechanical problems, and unauthorized individuals
  • Orally and physically de-escalating individuals, as needed
  • Inspect all security devices and fire control equipment
  • Screen members, visitors, and client employees to expedite their admittance to the facility
  • Respond to incidents of fire, medical emergency, bomb threat, flooding, water discharge, elevator emergency, hazardous materials, or inclement weather with calm urgency
  • May also include patient escort, patient watch, provide safety escort, assist and/or transport deceased to morgue

Minimum Requirements:

  • Prior work experience involving dealing with customers, troubleshooting, and/or managing stressful situations
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent, or 5 years of verifiable experience
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws. Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Schedules that fit with your personal life goals
  • Ongoing paid training programs and career growth opportunities
  • Employee discounts through our perks program to your favorite restaurants, entertainment venues and much more…

jobs.title: Warwick Melrose Dallas Hotel - Security
jobs.description:
About the position

The Security position at Warwick Melrose Dallas Hotel is pivotal in ensuring the safety and security of guests, staff, and property within the hotel premises. This role involves proactive monitoring and rapid response to any security incidents, maintaining a secure environment that supports a positive guest experience. The Security team member will collaborate closely with hotel management and local law enforcement when necessary to uphold safety standards and compliance with regulations. Through vigilant observation and effective communication, the role aims to prevent theft, vandalism, and other security breaches. Ultimately, this position contributes to the hotel's reputation as a safe and welcoming destination for all visitors.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor hotel premises through regular patrols and surveillance systems to detect and prevent suspicious activities.
  • Respond promptly and effectively to security incidents, emergencies, and alarms, ensuring guest and staff safety.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate reports of daily activities, incidents, and irregularities such as property damage or theft.
  • Collaborate with hotel management and local authorities to address security concerns and implement safety protocols.
  • Provide assistance and guidance to guests and staff regarding security policies and emergency procedures.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a security role, preferably in a hospitality or customer service environment.
  • Valid security guard license or certification as required by state law.
  • Ability to pass background checks and drug screening.
  • Strong observational skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Vigilance, quick decision-making, and effective communication are essential for daily security operations, enabling the security professional to identify potential threats and respond appropriately.
  • Observational skills help in monitoring surveillance equipment and conducting thorough patrols to maintain a safe environment.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience working in hotel or hospitality security.
  • First aid and CPR certification.
  • Familiarity with security technology such as CCTV systems and access control.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Training in conflict resolution and emergency response.
  • Familiarity with security technology enhances the ability to use modern tools for surveillance and incident documentation.
  • Interpersonal skills are crucial for interacting with guests and staff, providing reassurance and clear instructions during emergencies.
  • Additionally, conflict resolution and emergency response training empower the security team member to handle challenging situations calmly and efficiently, ensuring minimal disruption to hotel operations.

jobs.title: Director for Research Security
jobs.company: The University of Texas at Arlington
jobs.description:
Salary

The annual salary for this position ranges from $124,100 to $178,100. The final offer will be commensurate with the candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications.

Documents Needed to Apply

Required

  • Resume
  • Cover letter
  • References (minimum of three)

Purpose of Position

The Director oversees an integrated research security, export control, conflict of interest, and conflict of commitment program designed to protect the institution’s scientific and scholarly work, financial resources, intellectual property, as well as regulated and sensitive data while supporting open academic engagement. The Director serves as UTA’s Research Security Officer. The role is a strategic partner to campus leaders and the research community and is responsible for implementing risk-based approaches that assure the integrity and security of the university’s diverse research and innovation enterprise. The Director actively leads efforts to mitigate risks related to foreign adversaries and influence as well as insider threats associated with domestic and international research efforts as required by federal and state law.

Essential Functions

  • Develops and supports institutional governance frameworks, policies, and processes for an integrated program.
  • Leads university’s efforts to meet certification and statutory requirements.
  • Monitor regulatory updates and industry best practices to ensure the university's programs and employees remain compliant with applicable laws and regulations.
  • Serve as a primary institutional point of contact for research security matters with federal sponsors and external partners. Responsible for the direct supervision of staff.
  • Engages with research community to explore, understand, and address issues.
  • Create and maintain suite of electronic and informational resources/tools to independently and collaboratively assess and mitigate risk.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments to identify potential conflicts and institutional areas for improvement.
  • Leads coordination efforts with campus leaders and research stakeholders to examine and advance research security matters in research projects, international partnerships, and commercialization.
  • Ensure institutional compliance with sponsor disclosure rules as well as federal and state requirements.
  • Implement foreign travel training to countries of concern, heightened intel collection and ITAR.
  • Partners with information security and campus compliance to develop and implement campus-wide certifications that promote awareness of disclosure and research security obligations.
  • Lead investigations into program violations ensuring documentation and reporting of findings.
  • Resolve non-compliance issues and refer serious cases as appropriate.
  • Prepare reports for senior leadership, sponsors and regulatory agencies as required.
  • Develop, implement and monitor management plans for compliance and/or identified cases of violations.
  • Evaluate and mitigate risks related to foreign affiliations, talent recruitment programs, international collaborations, partnerships, foreign shipments and visiting scholars.
  • Develop processes and mitigation program for insider threat risks in partnership with information security and information technology.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Homeland Security, Global Security and Intelligence, Risk Management or a related field.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years of experience in a research security role with a federal contractor or within higher education, research, health, or a related industry in a role responsible for counterintelligence, investigations, insider threat, conflict of interest, intelligence analysis or related experience.
  • Experience must include a minimum of three (3) years of supervisory experience.
  • Must have experience working with government agencies (DoD, NIH, NSF, DOE, etc.), or in a regulated research environment subject to EAR, ITAR, OFAC, or similar compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in security or responsible conduct of research role.
  • 5 or more years of progressive leadership responsibility and supervisory experience.
  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience in research security and/or national security field.
  • Holds a federal security clearance of Secret or above.
  • Certified Insider Threat Analyst (CITA) and/or GIAC Open-Source Intelligence Certification (GOSI)
  • Certification or experience examining data logs in User Entity Behavior Analytical (UEBA) tools and/or other data aggregate tools.
  • Certification in trade compliance or export control.
  • Experience in developing risk matrices and intelligence report writing.
  • Experience as a Contract Program Security Officer (CPSO) familiar with safeguarding Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and Classified information.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of current suite of available Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) / Publicly Available Information (PAI) tools, databases, and repositories,
  • Strong proficiency in OSINT research and methodology.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated customer service and policy development skills.
  • Strong analytical with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to exercise discretion, judgement and integrity when making discission.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Skilled in making sound decisions when minimal information is available.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and multitask on a variety of projects.

Work Schedule

  • Monday through Friday; 8:00am through 5:00pm

Working Conditions

  • Repetitive use of a keyboard at a workstation.

jobs.title: Safety Admin (Data Centers)
jobs.description:
Data Center Safety Administrator

Reports To: Project Safety Manager / EHS Manager

Location: Project Site (Data Center Construction Project)

Position Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

The Data Center Safety Administrator is responsible for supporting project safety operations through document control, compliance tracking, onboarding administration, training records management, and contractor safety documentation. This position serves as the administrative backbone of the site safety team and is primarily office/trailer based.

The Safety Administrator works closely with project safety personnel, superintendents, subcontractors, and project management to ensure all workers are properly enrolled, trained, documented, and compliant with project safety requirements.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, computer proficient, and comfortable managing large volumes of documentation in a fast-paced construction environment.

Primary ResponsibilitiesContractor & Employee Onboarding

  • Coordinate and process all new worker onboarding requirements.
  • Verify required certifications, licenses, OSHA credentials, and training documentation.
  • Maintain worker enrollment records and site access documentation.
  • Assist with badging, orientation scheduling, and onboarding logistics.
  • Support project-specific orientation and site access requirements.

Safety Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain safety files for all project personnel and subcontractors.
  • Track and organize:
    • OSHA certifications
    • Training records
    • Fit testing records
    • Equipment certifications
    • Site-specific training documentation
    • Competent person documentation
  • Ensure documentation remains current and audit-ready.
  • Monitor expiration dates and notify project teams of upcoming renewals.
JHA / Permit Administration

  • Review submitted Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) for completeness.
  • Collect and maintain daily JHAs from subcontractors.
  • Track permit-required activities including:
    • Hot work permits
    • Confined space permits
    • Excavation permits
    • Energization permits
    • LOTO documentation
  • Maintain project permit logs and filing systems.
Safety Reporting & Data Management

  • Enter and maintain safety data in project tracking systems.
  • Compile daily, weekly, and monthly safety reports.
  • Track:
    • Headcount
    • Orientation metrics
    • Training completion
    • Safety observations
    • Near misses
    • Incident documentation
  • Assist with project safety scorecards and KPI reporting.
Audit & Inspection Support

  • Organize documentation for client audits and safety inspections.
  • Assist site safety leadership with audit preparation.
  • Maintain electronic and hard-copy safety records.
  • Ensure project files remain organized and accessible.

Project Administrative Support

  • Assist Safety Managers and Safety Officers with administrative tasks.
  • Coordinate meetings and maintain attendance records.
  • Prepare agendas, sign-in sheets, and training documentation.
  • Support project communication between field personnel and safety leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • 2+ years of administrative, safety, construction, or project coordination experience preferred.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills including:
    • Excel
    • Word
    • Outlook
    • Teams
  • Strong data entry and recordkeeping abilities.
  • Ability to maintain confidential information.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced construction environment.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Construction industry experience.
  • Data center or mission-critical project experience.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.
  • Experience with:
    • Procore
    • Autodesk Build
    • SmartSheet
    • ISNetworld
    • Avetta
    • Power BI
  • Experience supporting safety departments or EHS programs.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
Key Success Factors

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Strong computer and document management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Professional interaction with craft workers, subcontractors, clients, and project leadership.
  • Maintains audit-ready documentation at all times.
  • Supports a positive safety culture through accuracy, accountability, and responsiveness.

Typical Daily Activities

  • Process new-hire enrollments.
  • Collect and file JHAs.
  • Update headcount and orientation logs.
  • Track training and certification expirations.
  • Assist with safety meeting documentation.
  • Maintain permit logs.
  • Prepare reports for project leadership and client safety teams.
  • Support site safety personnel with administrative needs.

jobs.description:
Full Time, Nights, 6 pm - 6 am

At Houston Methodist, the Security Officer position is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for patients, staff and visitors by patrolling and monitoring hospital premises and personnel. This position provides assistance with personal protection, traffic control and emergency response services. The Security Officer position may employ Houston Methodist-approved defensive tactics to ensure patient, staff and visitor safety.

Non-exempt

EDUCATION

High School diploma or equivalent education (examples include: GED, verification of homeschool equivalency, partial or full completion of post-secondary education, etc.)

EXPERIENCE

Criminal justice, security or related experience preferred

Maintains high customer satisfaction while providing the highest level of safety and security to patients, visitors, staff and assets.

Uses professional telephone etiquette. Communicates effectively with management and coworkers on tasks, processes and procedures.

Promotes a positive work environment and contributes to a dynamic, team focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results. Contributes towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. peer-to-peer accountability.

Responds immediately to all emergency codes and takes appropriate action.

Maintains a safe environment, following all policies and procedures for safety, hazardous material, emergency preparedness and HIPAA.

Prevents loss and damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policy and procedures.

jobs.title: Underground Utility CCTV Operator- (Open to Entry Level)
jobs.description:
Underground Utility CCTV Operator- (Open to Entry Level) – Launch Your Underground Utility Career with Paid Training

Job Overview

  • Company: BCAC Underground, LLC
  • Salary/Pay Rate: 17.00–26.00 / hour
  • Location: Haltom City, TX
  • Job/Employment Type: Full Time
  • Schedule: Full Time
  • Mandatory Licences & Certifications: Valid Driver's License
  • Department: Field Operations
  • Reports To: Field Supervisor / Project Manager
  • FLSA Status: Non-Exempt (Hourly)

Job Overview

The Underground Utility CCTV Operator is responsible for the setup, operation, and post-processing of closed-circuit television (CCTV) inspection equipment used to assess the condition of underground infrastructure, including sanitary sewer mains, storm drains,

force mains, and related utility systems. The operator produces accurate inspection reports used by engineers, municipalities, and project managers to evaluate pipe conditions and prioritize rehabilitation or replacement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate mainline and lateral CCTV inspection equipment (crawler systems, push cameras, etc.) in accordance with project specifications and safety protocols
  • Perform pipeline inspections per NASSCO PACP, LACP, and MACP coding standards
  • Accurately code and document pipe defects, structural anomalies, and service connections in real time using industry-standard software (WinCan, ICOM, or equivalent)
  • Prepare and submit complete, accurate inspection reports including video, photos, and defect logs
  • Operate and maintain jetting/vacuum equipment when required for pre-cleaning pipes prior to inspection
  • Perform traffic control setup in accordance with MUTCD standards and applicable local requirements
  • Conduct confined space entry procedures and atmospheric testing in compliance with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146
  • Maintain, clean, and perform basic field repairs on all CCTV and associated equipment
  • Communicate daily with supervisors regarding inspection progress, site conditions, and any issues encountered
  • Ensure all work is performed in compliance with OSHA, DOT, and company safety standards
  • Complete daily field logs, equipment checklists, and timesheets accurately

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • Ability to pass background check, drug screening, and MVR check
  • Physical ability to work in outdoor environments and confined spaces

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • NASSCO PACP/LACP/MACP Certification-Will provide training
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 (Construction) certification-Will provide training
  • Confined Space Entry Certification-Will provide training
  • Experience with WinCan, ICOM, Granite XP, or similar pipeline inspection software
  • First Aid / CPR certification-Will provide training

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. regularly
  • Ability to work in confined spaces, manholes, and underground environments
  • Ability to stand, kneel, bend, and work in physically demanding field conditions
  • Comfortable working in all weather conditions including extreme heat and cold
  • Ability to work at or near active traffic lanes

Working Conditions

  • Outdoor field environment — municipal streets, easements, job sites
  • General Construction Conditions
  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.
  • Enthusiasm for learning software applications and robotic camera operations.

Compensation

  • 0 – 3 years experience $17-$20 / hr plus performance bonus
  • 4 – 6 years experience $21-$25 / hr plus performance bonus
  • 7+ years experience $26+ / hr plus performance bonus
  • Benefits may include health insurance, paid time off,

About Us

BCAC Underground, LLC is the industry standard for underground pipe and inspection services. We deliver top-of-the-line, safe, cost-effective, and environmentally responsible solutions to meet complex utility needs. We empower our workforce through competitive pay, robust benefit options, and continuous technical training.

Learn more at https://bcacunderground.com/.

BCAC Underground, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender expression, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or any other status protected by law or regulations. It is our intention that all qualified applicants be given equal opportunity and that selection decisions be based on job-related factors.

jobs.title: Protective Security Officer- Intermediate Level Job at USAA in SAN ANTONIO
jobs.description:
Why USAA?
At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice.
We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.
Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members.
Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.
The Opportunity
As a dedicated Protective Security Officer II, you will provides armed response to emergency incidents involving workplace violence, active shooters, duress situations, medical emergencies, access control violations, and other safety and security situations in protection of the workforce.
- Performs as a team member in enforcing established procedures under supervision.
- Performs routine duties and identifies and reports problems in accordance with standard operating procedures.
Supports Senior PSOs and Security Management with overall team performance.
We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 5 days per week.
This position can be based in one of the following location: San Antonio, TX.
Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
What you'll do:
* Understands and applies policies and procedures displaying basic knowledge on operational matters.
* Responds to critical incidents and takes direction on immediate actions to stop acts of violence, render first aid, and resolve issues during the response phase of Incident Management.
* Participates in training drills, receives feedback on response, and participates in after action reviews for emergency response situations.
* Monitors alarms, cameras, fire alarm systems, and access control programs along with radio traffic, dispatching officers, coordinating response actions for critical incidents and documenting activities for escalation to incident reports.
* Controls access for employees and visitors, creates and issues credentials, and responds to policy violations.
* Performs patrols of facilities/properties to prevent trespassing, theft, vandalism, parking/traffic infractions and unauthorized conduct impacting the safety of the campus.
* Enforces parking and traffic controls and composes incident reports.
* Completes duty assignments and on-the-job duty position training.
* Conducts post-related activities during special events and supports executive protection or law enforcement during incident response.
* Documents shift activities, and ensures detailed information is passed on to team members.
* Attends and completes all training sessions and responds to feedback from security management and the training team.
* Completes Defensive Tactics and Handgun training and Standards Evaluation, complies with USAA Force Continuum, issue/turn-in, storage/transportation procedures and maintains State handgun licensing.
* Maintains current first aid training.
* Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
What you have:
* High School Diploma, General Equivalency Diploma, or applicable trade/technical school diploma.
* 1 or more years of physical security, law enforcement, or military combat arms experience.
* Ability to operate computer programs for access control, camera systems, alarm annunciation, radio dispatch and general use of Microsoft Office tools to include Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Must possess valid state driver's license.
* Job Offer contingent on passing the MMPI evaluation.
* Initial and continued employment conditional upon passing USAA’s Protective Security training standards within 3 attempts (for initial and follow-on training cycles) and obtaining required state armed security license and/or certification for assigned post state within 6 months.
What sets you apart:
* Ability to work weekends, holidays, and overtime if required
* First Aid/CPR Certification
* Demonstrates firearm proficiency
* Possess a current Level III Texas private security board security license.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to respond rapidly and effectively during emergency situations.
* Previous military or law enforcement experience preferred as applicable
* Prior experience using security related systems.
Report management system, two-way radios, visitor management systems, and Microsoft Office suite of tools.
* Associates degree in Law Enforcement or Criminal Justice
* US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner [optional]

  • Help supervise operations of an assigned Client site on assigned shift.

  • Manage a team of security officers, including participating in scheduling, payroll, training, coaching, development and support.
  • Ensure the Client Site is provided with high quality security services to protect people and property.
  • Handle all escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately.
  • Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, recognition, etc.).

  • Identify all tenants and/or visitors upon arrival.
  • Ensure visitors and vendors are properly signed in prior to accessing the building.
  • Observe departing personnel to guard against theft of tenant or building property.
  • Monitor security cameras that are within the facility.
  • Respond to incidents including property emergencies.
  • Conduct general patrols of the entire property during various hours, if required, including numerous flights of stairs and frequent patrols of the exterior in any weather conditions.
  • Ability to stand/sit/walk for extended periods of time.
  • Assist tenants and visitors with directions and general business information.
  • Clearly and accurately record data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, and malfunctioning of equipment, to building and Titan management.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Bi-lingual considered a plus.

Hotel Security Officers have a broad role focused on protecting guests, employees, property, and hotel operations while providing a professional presence.

jobs.title: Warehouse 2nd Shift Shipping Supervisor
jobs.description:
At Concordance Healthcare Solutions, we believe that each team member makes a difference in driving our purpose of positively impacting lives forward. Concordance is committed to our guiding principles of financial stewardship, accountability, forward thinking, aligned relationships and an inclusive culture. This is done through maintaining an unwavering amount of respect and commitment with our employees and customers, being authentic to who we are and operating with the highest levels of integrity. Through our dedicated staff of over 750 employees, working in strategically-located distribution centers across the country, we offer dynamic supply chain solutions to the entire healthcare continuum.
We have a job opening for a full-time 2nd Shift Shipping Supervisor in our Chicago, IL distribution center. The primary role of the Shipping Supervisor is providing leadership and direction for the Shipping department in this location; overseeing handling of merchandise for shipment and departmental staff as efficiently, safely and productively as possible, to ensure that customer expectations are exceeded. Shift time includes 1:00pm to 10:00pm; overtime required.
Essential Functions:
  • The Shipping Supervisor will be responsible for overall management of the Shipping Department in the Chicago location.
  • Responsibilities include organizing the daily workload of department and directs employees accordingly. Works to ensure freight and packages are being moved to destinations on time.
  • Play a key role in interviewing and hiring quality staff members; overseeing a strong training regimen for new staff; continuously developing new and experienced workers; managing staff; and completing performance management reviews on assigned employees twice a year.
  • Oversees and is directly involved (hands on) in the following Shipping operations: productivity, quality, freight handling, including, but not limited to, customer service, and safety. This role is responsible for ensuring prompt, efficient and accurate handling of merchandise as well as developing and implementing team goals.
  • In addition to supervising Shipping staff, this position is also responsible for providing leadership by example while assisting with daily shipping functions. This includes performing duties, such as building and consolidating pallets of customer shipment; organization and staging of the department; preparing orders for shipment with external carriers, such as UPS and FedEx and other various duties.
  • Ensures that departments keep a clean and orderly work environment. Assigns general custodial tasks and establishes cleaning schedule for areas. Supports a healthy and safe work environment by communicating unsafe conditions immediately.
  • Maintains warehouse equipment to ensure safety of employees; addresses any mechanical issues that are reported.
  • Works proactively to foster and maintain a positive team-oriented atmosphere at all times.
  • Other duties as assigned.
What You will Need to be Successful:
  • High school diploma, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of three years of related experience required and one year in warehouse operations or distribution is preferred.
  • Previous experience supervising, training, developing and providing direction to staff a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of Voice Pick and VAI systems (or similar warehouse management or operating system) is preferred.
  • Must be able to lift/pull/carry at least 70 pounds; must be willing/able to stand and walk for entire shift, often over 8 hours. With or without accommodation.
  • Strong customer service, problem solving, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to effectively build relationships are essential.
  • Self-starter with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively as a member of a team.
  • Successfully pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check and drug screening.
Work Location:
  • This role is located in Chicago, IL.

Compensation: $65,000-$70,000 annually.

North Chicago Alert: We are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate to join our local team. This is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking for part-time work with $22.25/hr potential.

Tags: #NorthChicagoJobs #PartTime #Warehouse



About UPS & Our Culture

It sounds too good to be true — part-time hours with full-time quality benefits. But at UPS, it has been the reality for decades, and it is one of the primary reasons our part-time workforce has some of the highest retention rates in the logistics industry. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions with benefits are the rare exception in the American labor market — roles where Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision coverage, pension contributions, and paid personal time are available to associates working as few as 17.5 hours per week. When you search for warehouse jobs with benefits near me, nothing else on the market delivers what UPS does at the part-time level.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I took this job because my family needed health insurance and I could not afford individual coverage. UPS's Teamsters medical plan costs me a fraction of what individual insurance costs, covers my entire family, and is genuinely better coverage than what my spouse gets at their full-time job. I work 20 hours a week, I am home by 9:30 AM every morning, and my family's healthcare is completely handled. For anyone searching for warehouse jobs with benefits at part-time hours, UPS is completely in its own league." - Current Part-Time Associate with Benefits, Nashville, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Warehouse Associate with Benefits, you work a structured 3.5 to 5 hour sort shift inside our package center, performing the core loading, sorting, and unloading functions that keep the UPS delivery network running — and accessing a benefits package that most part-time employers do not even attempt to offer.

  • Core Sort Functions: Execute UPS's standard sort operation tasks — unloading trailers, sorting packages on conveyor systems, and loading delivery vehicles in sequence order — building skill and speed across all three functions over time on a consistent part-time schedule.
  • Benefits Enrollment Navigation: Work with UPS's onboarding team to enroll in Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision benefits, understand your pension accrual schedule, and register for the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program within your first weeks on the job.
  • Consistent Schedule Reliability: Maintain consistent attendance across your assigned part-time shift window — the foundation on which your Teamsters union seniority, annual wage progression, and long-term benefits eligibility are all built.

Benefits & Perks

This UPS part-time position includes the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and eligible dependents, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance covering up to $25,000 in education costs. Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.

jobs.description:
Location: Chicago Downtown Campus

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $22.00 Hour

To access a list of benefits for full-time jobs, click here.

Join a Mission-Driven Team

Do you have a heart for service, a commitment to safety, and a desire to make a meaningful impact? Moody Bible Institute is seeking a Public Safety Officer to help create a secure and welcoming environment for our students, employees, residents, and guests on our Chicago campus. As part of our Public Safety team, you will play a vital role in protecting our community while supporting Moody's mission of equipping people with the truth of God's Word.

About Us

Moody Bible Institute is a Christ-centered higher education and media ministry dedicated to equipping people with the truth of God's Word. Through trusted biblical teaching, media, and educational resources, Moody reaches audiences around the world with the gospel and seeks to make a lasting Kingdom impact.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief of Public Safety, the Public Safety Officer is responsible for maintaining the safety and security of Moody Bible Institute's Chicago campus through proactive patrols, emergency response, incident management, and community engagement. This role requires sound judgment, professionalism, and a servant-hearted approach to serving others.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct foot and vehicle patrols to deter and identify security concerns.
  • Serve as a primary responder to campus incidents, alarms, emergency calls, and 911 notifications.
  • Assess, manage, and secure incident scenes while coordinating with emergency responders and city officials.
  • Prepare accurate, timely, and detailed incident reports and related documentation.
  • Monitor and oversee part-time staff and dispatch operations during assigned shifts.
  • Enforce campus policies, including parking regulations and access control procedures.
  • Provide security coverage for campus events and activities.
  • Assist students, employees, and visitors by providing information, guidance, and support.
  • Issue trespass notices when necessary and respond to unauthorized access concerns.
  • Provide security escorts, cash transport support, and executive protection services as assigned.
  • Complete additional departmental duties and special assignments as directed.

Key Qualifications

  • Associate degree or two years of related security, public safety, law enforcement, military, or customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • At least 21 years of age.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in emergency situations.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice or a related field.
  • Illinois PERC Card.
  • Illinois FOID Card.
  • Experience responding to fire, medical, or security incidents.
  • Previous security, law enforcement, campus safety, or military experience.

Work Environment

  • This position is based on Moody Bible Institute's downtown Chicago campus and includes both outdoor and indoor responsibilities.
  • Officers regularly patrol campus on foot and in vehicles, respond to emergencies, and interact with a diverse campus community.
  • The role requires standing, walking, climbing stairs, and working in varying weather conditions.

Schedule

This position follows an overnight shift schedule, consisting of three 12-hour shifts (6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m.) per week, with a rotating fourth weekend shift as needed.

What We Offer

  • Mission-driven work that impacts lives for Christ.
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees.
  • A vibrant campus community in the heart of downtown Chicago.

Additional Information

  • Candidates must align with Moody Bible Institute’s Christian identity, including signing a Statement of Faith and adhering to Community Standards
  • Moody Bible Institute values diversity and seeks team members who engage others in ways that honor its biblical foundation
  • Moody complies with applicable nondiscrimination laws and, as a religious institution, requires employees to hold beliefs consistent with its Doctrinal Statement and Community Standards

Join Us

If you are a service-oriented professional who values integrity, teamwork, and faith-based ministry, we invite you to apply. Join a team that is committed to protecting our community while advancing Moody's mission of developing people who influence the world for Christ.

About UPS & Our Culture

Friday evening through Sunday night — that is when the UPS weekend operation runs at its highest volume, and it is when our Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers earn some of the strongest hourly rates in our entire package center network. If your Monday-through-Friday schedule is locked and you are hunting for weekend warehouse jobs that actually pay well, offer union benefits, and leave every weekday untouched, UPS weekend shifts were designed specifically for you. We are one of the only employers in the logistics industry offering weekend warehouse jobs near me with full Teamsters union representation, meaning your weekend hours come with the same contractual protections and pay guarantees as any full-time role.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I have a full-time desk job Monday through Friday and I work UPS weekends to pay down my mortgage faster. The weekend differential on top of the union wage makes the hourly rate genuinely excellent, and I get my full weekdays completely untouched. In two years I have built a serious financial cushion on this schedule. If you are looking for legitimate weekend warehouse jobs near me that respect your weekday life, UPS is it." - Current Weekend Package Handler, Indianapolis, IN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handler, you work Friday evening through Sunday sort shifts inside our package center, processing the weekend's elevated residential delivery and pickup volume that builds throughout the week and peaks on Saturday and Sunday sort windows.

  • Weekend Volume Processing: Sort, load, and unload the high-density package volume that accumulates through the week, operating at peak throughput across Friday night, Saturday, and Sunday shifts to clear the facility for Monday morning delivery routes.
  • Weekend Surge Handling: Navigate the additional volume generated by weekend e-commerce orders and residential pickups, adapting quickly to higher-than-weekday sort targets that UPS weekend shifts routinely reach.
  • Trailer Loading & Unloading: Pull inbound packages from arriving trailers and build outbound loads in package cars and linehaul lanes, using UPS-approved stacking methods to maintain load quality standards across all weekend shifts.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers receive a weekend shift differential on top of the Teamsters base union wage. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance apply regardless of your part-time weekend schedule. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday. Your entire Monday-through-Friday schedule remains completely untouched.

jobs.description:
Your Next Step in Lombard

Role in Lombard: Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate Hiring Organization: UPS Location: Lombard, IL

Compensation: $21-$23/Hour (approx. $26.6k/Year) Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included. Stable workload with modern tooling and processes.

What You'll Do

Apply your your professional skills skills at our Lombard location.

  • This Lombard-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Lombard, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Lombard, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

The twilight shift is one of the highest-volume sort windows in the entire UPS network, processing the enormous wave of packages picked up from businesses throughout the workday. If you are searching for UPS warehouse jobs that align perfectly with a daytime school schedule or a morning-shift primary job, our twilight sort operation — typically running 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM — is the ideal entry into one of America's most respected logistics careers. These warehouse jobs come with full union representation and real long-term potential.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The twilight shift fits my life perfectly. I go to class in the morning, work at UPS in the evening, and my tuition is being covered by Earn & Learn. The shift itself is fast and the team is incredibly motivated — everyone knows we have a hard window to hit and we go after it together. These are the best UPS warehouse jobs for students, hands down." - Current Twilight Warehouse Associate, Chicago, IL.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate, you process the peak commercial pickup volume of the day during the evening sort window. You will rotate through loading, sorting, and unloading functions as directed by your sort manager within our package center.

  • Commercial Pickup Processing: Sort the high-density commercial package volume collected from business pickups during the day, routing each parcel accurately onto outbound belts and trailers for overnight transport.
  • Multi-Function Rotation: Work fluidly across unloading, sorting, and loading assignments as the twilight sort manager redistributes labor to balance throughput across the facility's busiest evening hours.
  • Sort Accuracy Compliance: Maintain UPS's required sort accuracy rate by carefully verifying destination labels and barcode scans before releasing any package onto an outbound conveyor.

Benefits & Perks

Twilight Warehouse Associates receive Teamsters union wages with annual progression raises, medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition program. The evening shift window makes this one of the most student-friendly warehouse jobs in the market.
